title: PhD position or Postdoctoral researcher (m/f/d) (Geophysiker/in)
description: PhD position or Postdoctoral researcher (m/f/d): Effects of global livestock management on wildlife movementSenckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre (SBiK-F), starting as of 01 January2027:PhD position or Postdoctoral researcher (m/f/d):Effects of global livestock management on wildlife movementitel (m/f/d)(Part-Time)Location: Frankfurt am MainEmployment scope: PhD position (65%) / PostDoc (up to 60%)Type of contract: Temporary, limited to 4 years, until 31.12.20230Remuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E 13The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.The mission of the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre is to study the complex interactions between biodiversity, climate and society.As part of the Centre, the group “Global Land Systems and Biodiversity” takes a system perspective on how production, trade and consumption of food and other biomass products affect ecosystems and people.The VEBITA project, conducted jointly by SGN, the Marburg University and the Institute for Social-Ecological Research (ISOE) brings together researchers and practice partners to work towards utilizing animal movement data for early-warning systems for nature conservation. By analyzing GPS and sensor data from animals with statistical and AI-based methods, VEBITA aims to detect how animal behaviors change in response to land use, climate change, habitat loss, infrastructure development, and other environmental pressures.The adverstised position focuses on the effects of livestock management on wildlife movements contributes a use-case for state-of-the art animal movement data. Currently, livestock keeping has the largest spatial footprint of all land uses and the global biomass of mammalian livestock exceeds that of all remaining wild mammals by an order of magnitude. How and where livestock are kept greatly impacts the movements of the remaining wild mammals.In this context, we seek to develop a refined biodiversity footprint approach that captures how different livestock management strategies impact movement of wild mammals and how management can be adapted to achieve more sustainable outcomes. This subproject is part of VEBITA’s transdisciplinary focus, and the design of the novel footprint approach will consider perspectives of different relevant societal stakeholder groups such as livestock farmers, conservationists, and regulators. Results and insights of this work will also feed back to international science-policy debates on how conservation and human activities can be aligned in the future.Your tasks- Advance existing biodiversity footprint approaches in the context of livestock production and wildlife movement- Classify global livestock management systems- Analyze global patterns of how livestock keeping influences movements of wild mammals- Actively engage in exchange and cooperation within VEBITA’s inter- and transdisciplinary project team- Participate in project meetings and contribute to project reporting- Publish results in international journals in cooperation with the project teamYour profile- MSc degree (or equivalent) for application for a PhD position or PhD degree for application as postdoctoral researcher in a relevant field, e.g., sustainability science, physical geography, ecology or another relevant field- Programming skills (R, Python or similar), familiarity in working with heterogenous datasets and their analysis- Excellent English language skills- Interest in working in an inter- and transdisciplinary project- Interest in applied science at the science-policy interfaceDesirable skills- Experience with stakeholder interactionsWe offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.How to apply?Please upload your application as a single PDF by 19 November 2026, stating the reference number Ref. #11-26021, including:- cover letter describing your motivation to apply for this position- detailed CV- contact details of two potential references- all academic credentials and certificatesPlease submit your application via our online application system. If you are viewing this vacancy on an external job platform, please visit our careers page and apply via the corresponding "Apply" button. Applications submitted by email cannot be considered.If you have any specific questions about the position, please contact Prof. Dr. Thomas Kastner at thomas.kastner@senckenberg.de.ContactSenckenberg Gesellschaft für NaturforschungSenckenberganlage 2560325 Frankfurt am MainFor specific questions about this role, please contact xxxxx atvorname.nachname@senckenberg.deFor data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/Please visit our website at www.senckenberg.de for further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung.Application documents will also be made available to members of the selection committee from Marburg University and the Institute for Social-Ecological Research (ISOE), solely for the purpose of assessing applications and selecting candidates.

title: Senior Product Analyst - Quick Commerce (Fixed-term) (Data-Analyst/in)
description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Senior Product AnalystStellenbeschreibung:Company DescriptionAs the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.Job DescriptionJob Ref ID: JR0087496We are on the lookout for a Senior Product Analyst, Quick Commerce - (Fixed Term) to join the Local Shops team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences. You'll drive data-informed decision-making across Local Shops, directly shaping how we scale and optimize our quick commerce offering.Be part of redefining how customers experience quick commerce. You'll help build technology that scales our non-food offerings, reaching new market segments and driving revenue growth. By innovating within our Quick Commerce Team, you'll make Delivery Hero the go-to platform for a broad range of products, helping us grow faster and deliver more value to customers around the world.You'll turn complex product and operational data into actionable insights, working with product managers, engineers, and business teams to shape strategy, optimize features, and make sure initiatives deliver measurable business value. Your focus will be the onboarding and integration domain, which directly affects the vendor onboarding and integration experience and drives business growth. This is a high-impact role for a senior analyst who wants real analytical ownership. You'll work with state-of-the-art in-house tooling that processes billions of orders, and own key initiatives end to end with full autonomy.In This RoleYou Will Partner closely with Local Shops product managers, engineers, and data scientists to define hypotheses, KPIs, and success criteria for product and operational initiatives.You'll own the full analytics lifecycle: defining tracking instrumentation, running data discovery on product usage and operational metrics, designing experiments, assessing impacts, and building dashboards.Your insights will shape product roadmaps and feature prioritization, directly impacting our ability to scale Local Shops.You'll translate complex data into clear, compelling narratives for stakeholders at all levels.Key Responsibilities- Collaborate with product managers and cross-functional teams to define hypotheses, success metrics, and strategic initiatives for Local Shops product line- Conduct in-depth analyses of operational and product performance metrics to identify trends, inefficiencies, and growth opportunities- Support the implementation of tracking and instrumentation strategies; ensure data integrity and completeness- Design and execute experiments (A/B tests, quasi-experiments) to evaluate product features, pricing strategies, and operational changes- Establish causal inference approaches to understand what drives key metrics and business outcomes- Generate business intelligence solutions and dashboards to communicate insights clearly to PMs, leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders- Document analytical frameworks, KPIs, and insights to ensure smooth continuity with the permanent analyst before contract endQualifications- 5+ years of experience in Product Analytics or Data Analytics, ideally in a fast-paced, product-driven environment- Strong technical expertise in analytics stack: advanced SQL (BigQuery preferred), data visualization tools (Tableau, Google Data Studio), and A/B testing platforms (Optimizely, Adobe Target)- Experience with event tracking and instrumentation tools (Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Mixpanel, or similar)- Understanding of statistical concepts, experimental design, and A/B testing methodologies- Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills — experienced working cross-functionally with product, engineering, data science, and business teams- AI tool literacy — comfortable using AI tools (Claude, Gemini) for analysis and documentationNice to Have- Data manipulation in Python or R Experience with data scheduling and orchestration tools (Airflow, GitHub, dbt)- Familiarity with big data infrastructure, data pipelines, and ETL Experience with causal inference or quasi-experimental methods- Quick commerce, e-commerce, or grocery delivery domain knowledge- Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or related field)Additional InformationEnsuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. title: 2 Postdoctoral Researchers (ecologists) (m/f/d) (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
description: Senckenberg – Leibniz Institution for Biodiversity and Earth System Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at its Department of River Ecology and Conservation in Gelnhausen, starting as soon as possible2 Postdoctoral Researchers (ecologists) (m/f/d)(full-time / part-time)Location: GelnhausenEmployment scope: full-time / part-time options are availableType of contract: limited two years / an extension is be possibleRemuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) E 13Senckenberg is one of the world’s leading research institutions in the field of Biodiversity and Earth System Research, with eight research institutes and three natural history museums across Germany and scientists from over 40 nations. Our headquarter is located in the thriving commercial metropolis of Frankfurt in the heart of Germany, which also hosts one of our most famous facilities, the Senckenberg Natural History Museum. The location of the available position is in a Senckenberg institute about 40 kilometers east of Frankfurt in Gelnhausen, a historic town accessible via public transport (rail and bus).We are looking for enthusiastic ecologists with a background in broad-scale biodiversity change, community ecology, macroecology, metacommunities, and/or analysis of ecological time series.The two positions are embedded in one or more of the following projects:1. Synthesis Center on Freshwater Biodiversity Change in Europe The Synthesis Center brings together and supports a broad variety of researchers and practitioners investigating a broad variety of fundamental and applied ecological questions, with a particular focus on broad-scale and long-term biodiversity change, community ecology, freshwater ecology, time series analyses, multiple stressor impacts, and conservation (see doi.org/10.1038/s41586-023-06400-1 for an example). Data for > 30,000 freshwater biodiversity time series across 30 European countries have already been compiled from rivers and lakes, covering invertebrates, fish, macrophytes, diatoms, and benthic algae, in collaboration with a large pan-European network of > 200 researchers. Positions involved in this project are expected to pursue similar questions using the already available data.2. EU Horizon Europe project BEAGLE (started on 1st October 2026)BEAGLE (Biodiversity methods for advanced monitoring at large scales) is an EU-funded project using new technology to enhance biodiversity monitoring across terrestrial, freshwater, and marine environments. Specifically, the project uses sensors, environmental DNA (eDNA) and AI, as well as citizen science to collect large-scale and high-quality biodiversity data across a consortium of 17 partners. Positions involved in this project will focus on several tasks, including European-scale biodiversity data mobilization activities (e.g., tracking down datasets and preparing them for use), and the learning and deployment of field-based methods for data collection (e.g., Malaise traps). Participating researchers will gain experience in broad-scale biodiversity data collection and management, biodiversity monitoring, and participation in European-scale research networks.Your tasks• Contributing scientifically to one or more of the above-described projects (you can indicate a preference in your application if you have one)• Analyzing spatial and temporal biodiversity data, and accompanied environmental data, to elucidate spatial patterns and temporal trends and drivers thereof• Preparing scientific manuscripts• Attending project meetings and preparing project reports• Mentoring graduate students• Giving oral presentations at national and international conferences• Attending virtual and physical project meetingsYour profile• PhD in Ecology or a related field• Solid background in fields related to the above expected tasks for a given project or projects.• Advanced skills in statistical analyses, using R• Skills in project management and report writing are preferred but not essential• Strong publication record for your current career level• Excellent written and oral communication and project presentation skills in EnglishWe offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.How to apply?Please upload your application (letter outlining your suitability for the post, a detailed CV, contact details of 2 references, a list of publications and acquired funding electronically (as a single PDF) stating the **reference #04-26004 by November 22nd, 2026 **using the application form on our website https://www.senckenberg.de/de/karriere/ContactSenckenberg Gesellschaft für NaturforschungSenckenberganlage 2560325 Frankfurt a.M.If you have any specific questions about this role position, please contact Prof. Dr. Peter Haase at peter.haase@senckenberg.de.

title: PostDoc position (m/f/d) in  Data-Driven Social-Ecological Research (Umweltwissenschaftler/in)
description: Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre (SBiK-F), starting as soon as possible:PostDoc (m/f/d) in Data-Driven Social Ecological Research(Full-Time / Part-Time** **options available)Location: Frankfurt am MainEmployment scope: Full-Time; Part-Time options are availableType of contract: Temporary, limited to 3 yearsRemuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E13The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.The mission of the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre is to study the complex interactions between biodiversity, climate and society.SBiK-F has strong cooperations with the Institute for social-ecological research (ISOE) and the position will work closely with both institutions.The position develops quantitative approaches to (1) better characterize and measure human–nature interactions, or (2) use these analyses to identify leverage points for more effective stewardship or monitoring of nature under climate change.Your tasks- Develop quantitative approaches to measure and analyze human–nature interactions- Integrate multiple data streams (ecological, social, remote-sensing, citizen-science) into coherent models of social-ecological system dynamics- Identify leverage points where intervention or monitoring most effectively supports biodiversity- Advance biodiversity or stewardship monitoring frameworks to better incorporate social dimensions- Publish in leading international journals- Contribute to and connect with ongoing research at SBiK-F- Collaborate across the natural- and social-science groups at Senckenberg, ISOE, and partner institutionsYour profile- PhD in ecology, environmental science, quantitative social science, or a related field- Demonstrated experience working with empirical ecological data and preferably also social data- Strong proficiency in R (and/or comparable statistical/programming environments)- Excellent quantitative and statistical skills- Strong publication record in international peer-reviewed journals- Fluency in written and spoken EnglishDesirable skills- Experience with integrating heterogeneous data streams (eg. ecological, social, remote sensing or citizen science data)- Familiarity with AI/ML methods- Track record of interdisciplinary collaboration across natural and social sciences- Experience in quantitative social science methods and working with social or socio-economic data- Experience in acquiring third-party funding- Familiarity with trait-based approaches to social-ecological questions- Familiarity with adaptive capacity and resilience of social-ecological systems- Familiarity with impacts of climate change on the interactions between biodiversity and societyWe offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.How to apply?Please upload your application (letter of motivation with a short description of your previous and current research foci, a CV with full publication list, copies of certificates and diplomas, along with the names of two referees), electronically (as a single PDF) stating the reference: #11-26026 by 29.11.2026.Please submit your application via our online application system. If you are viewing this vacancy on an external job platform, please visit our careers page and apply via the corresponding "Apply" button. Applications submitted by email cannot be considered.Please be aware, application documents will also be made available to members of the selection committee from the Institute for Social-Ecological Research (ISOE), solely for the purpose of assessing applications and selecting candidates.ContactSenckenberg Gesellschaft für NaturforschungSenckenberganlage 2560325 Frankfurt am MainFor specific questions about this role, please contact Prof. Dr. Thomas Müller atThomas Müller.For data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/Please visit our website at www.senckenberg.de for further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung.

title: Doctoral Fellowship field of Sociology (Soziologe/Soziologin)
description: In the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, researchers from the Social Sciences and Humanities as well as artists explore the relationships between technology, science, and society. The Lab was initiated by The Schaufler Foundation together with TUD Dresden University of Technology. The Lab's guiding theme for the upcoming third funding phase (April 2027–September 2030) is "Energy Cultures in Transition". The guiding theme is investigated from a humanities, cultural, social, and educational science perspective, explored through artistic practice, and communicated to the public. Building on the dynamically growing research fields of the Energy Humanities, Science & Technology Studies, and the Digital Humanities, the aim is to examine how modern energy regimes—from petromodernity, to nuclear culture, and post-carbon futures—have shaped not only material infrastructures but also subjectivities, power relations, progress narratives, geopolitical orders, ecologies, and knowledge systems, while simultaneously being shaped by them. Interdisciplinary perspectives from the social sciences, cultural studies, humanities, and educational research represented at the Schaufler Kolleg@TU Dresden enable the analysis of the multifaceted entanglements of energy, culture, and society. The focus is on questions concerning the representation, communication, and aesthetics of energy transitions and resource paradigms as well as continuities between resource economies and information economies, the relationships between energy, labor, environment, and consumer culture, and the role of colonialism, gender, nationalism, geopolitics, education, and social justice in deciding energy futures and navigating collective transformation processes. In the fields of Applied Linguistics and Digital Humanities, the following research areas and questions are of particular relevance to the guiding theme:- Discursive negotiations, conceptualisations and metaphorisations of energy relations and energy transformations in various social domains (politics, the economy, technological development, civil society, etc.) and media contexts, including multimodal aspects- Formats, practices and impacts of science communication (analogue and digital) relating to energy-related researchTasks:Your tasks include independent research and academic further qualification with the goal of completing a doctorate at TUD, as well as writing a dissertation on a topic within the guiding concept "Energy Cultures in Transition" in the disciplines of Applied Linguistics or Digital Humanities. The fellowship requires a high degree of willingness to engage in interdisciplinary dialogue, particularly with the STEM partnerships of the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, as well as to conduct joint research with artists within the framework of the Schaufler Residency. In addition, engagement in the areas of science communication and outreach is expected. Shared office spaces will be made available to the fellows. Participation in the Kolleg's English-language training program is mandatory.Requirements:You hold an excellent university degree (Master’s or equivalent) in German Studies, Linguistics, Digital Humanities or a comparable discipline. Furthermore, you have relevant prior experience in the linguistic, cultural or media studies analysis of discourses on environmental, technological or energy-related issues. Experience with digital research methods (such as corpus linguistics, text mining and network analysis) would be an advantage. You have a strong ability to work in teams and enjoy interdisciplinary collaboration. As the training program is conducted in English, you have English skills at a minimum of C1 level. In accordance with the doctoral regulations of the Faculty of Linguistics, Literature and Cultural Studies, the dissertation may be written in either German or English—if you choose to write it in German, corresponding German language skills are required. Beyond this, German language skills are desirable but not mandatory.We offer:The opportunity to pursue a doctorate within the Schaufler Kolleg with a structured qualification program and integration into an interdisciplinary research project. You will receive a fully equipped office workspace on the premises of TUD and access to an excellent research infrastructure, including participation in Research Studios and writing retreats. The Graduate Academy and other central institutions of TUD offer numerous further training and qualification opportunities. In addition, within the limits of the available project funds, the Schaufler Lab will cover the costs of conference travel. Inclusion and equal opportunities are important to us. We therefore look forward to receiving applications from people regardless of gender, origin, sexual orientation, worldview, or disability. TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The University is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment. The fellowship does not constitute an employment relationship.Application:Your detailed application, in German or English, should contain, in addition to the completed online application form (https://tu-dresden.de/gsw/schauflerlab/schaufler-kolleg/phase-3/anmeldung-registration) , a letter of motivation, a curriculum vitae in tabular form including an account of your academic career, a copy of your most recent university degree certificate, an exposé of your research project including a work and time schedule (max. 20,000 characters). title: Doctoral Fellowship field of Sociology (Soziologe/Soziologin)
description: In the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, researchers from the Social Sciences and Humanities as well as artists explore the relationships between technology, science, and society. The Lab was initiated by The Schaufler Foundation together with TUD Dresden University of Technology. The Lab's guiding theme for the upcoming third funding phase (April 2027–September 2030) is "Energy Cultures in Transition". The guiding theme is investigated from a humanities, cultural, social, and educational science perspective, explored through artistic practice, and communicated to the public. For the third funding phase, the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden comprises eight doctoral fellowships and an annually changing Artist in Residence program.TUD embodies a university culture that is characterized by cosmopolitanism, mutual appreciation, thriving innovation and active participation. For TUD, diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.The Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden offers, subject to the availability of resources, aDoctoral Fellowshipfor a period of 2 years, with the option of extension by 1.5 years, starting on April 1, 2027. The fellowship (EUR 1,850 per month, plus a grant for material costs of EUR 150 and, where applicable, a family supplement of EUR 315 per child) is aimed at early-career researchers in the field of Sociology. Primary supervision will be provided by Prof. Dr. Susann Wagenknecht, Chair of Micro-Sociology and Technosocial Interaction.The guiding theme Energy Cultures in Transition understands energy as a cultural phenomenon deeply inscribed in aesthetic, historical, political, ecological, economic, and socio-technological practices and systems. Building on the dynamically growing research fields of the Energy Humanities, Science & Technology Studies, and the Digital Humanities, the aim is to examine how modern energy regimes—from petromodernity, to nuclear culture, and post-carbon futures—have shaped not only material infrastructures but also subjectivities, power relations, progress narratives, geopolitical orders, ecologies, and knowledge systems, while simultaneously being shaped by them. Interdisciplinary perspectives from the social sciences, cultural studies, humanities, and educational research represented at the Schaufler Kolleg@TU Dresden enable the analysis of the multifaceted entanglements of energy, culture, and society. The focus is on questions concerning the representation, communication, and aesthetics of energy transitions and resource paradigms as well as continuities between resource economies and information economies, the relationships between energy, labor, environment, and consumer culture, and the role of colonialism, gender, nationalism, geopolitics, education, and social justice in deciding energy futures and navigating collective transformation processes. In the field of Sociology, the following research areas and questions are of particular relevance to the guiding theme:- The (conflict-ridden) negotiation of imaginaries, infrastructures, institutional frameworks, and/or externalities (e.g., emissions, waste, waste heat) associated with energy production and supply across a wide variety of practices, communities, networks, organizations, markets, fields, and/or assemblagesTasks:Your tasks include independent research and academic further qualification with the goal of completing a doctorate at TUD, as well as writing a dissertation on a topic within the guiding concept "Energy Cultures in Transition" in the discipline of Sociology. The fellowship requires a high degree of willingness to engage in interdisciplinary dialogue, particularly with the STEM partnerships of the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, as well as to conduct joint research with artists within the framework of the Schaufler Residency. In addition, engagement in the areas of science communication and outreach is expected. Shared office spaces will be made available to the fellows. Participation in the Kolleg's English-language training program is mandatory.Requirements:You hold an excellent university degree in Sociology or a comparable field in the social sciences, as well as relevant previous experience in the sociological analysis of the environment, technology, or energy, and/or in the field of Science and Technology Studies. You have a strong ability to work in teams and enjoy interdisciplinary collaboration. As the training program is conducted in English, you have English skills at a minimum of C1 level. In accordance with the doctoral regulations of the Faculty of Arts, Humanities and Social Science, the dissertation may be written in either German or English—if you choose to write it in German, corresponding German language skills are required. Beyond this, German language skills are desirable but not mandatoryWe offer:The opportunity to pursue a doctorate within the Schaufler Kolleg with a structured qualification program and integration into an interdisciplinary research project. You will receive a fully equipped office workspace on the premises of TUD and access to an excellent research infrastructure, including participation in Research Studios and writing retreats. The Graduate Academy and other central institutions of TUD offer numerous further training and qualification opportunities. In addition, within the limits of the available project funds, the Schaufler Lab will cover the costs of conference travel. Inclusion and equal opportunities are important to us. We therefore look forward to receiving applications from people regardless of gender, origin, sexual orientation, worldview, or disability. TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The University is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment. The fellowship does not constitute an employment relationship.Application: Your detailed application, in German or English, should contain, in addition to the completed online application form (https://tu-dresden.de/gsw/schauflerlab/schaufler-kolleg/phase-3/anmeldung-registration) , a letter of motivation, a curriculum vitae in tabular form including an account of your academic career, a copy of your most recent university degree certificate, an exposé of your research project including a work and time schedule (max. 20,000 characters). Please send us your application documents, including the online application form, quoting the reference number s26-008, by November 24, 2026 (stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD applies), preferably via the TUD SecureMail Portal https://securemail.tu-dresden.de (https://securemail.tu-dresden.de/)  by sending it as a single pdf file to schaufler.lab@tu-dresden.de (https://mailto:schaufler.lab@tu-dresden.de) or to:TU Dresden, Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, Prof. Dr. Susann Wagenknecht, Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany.Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. Expenses incurred in attending interviews cannot be reimbursed.TUD is a founding partner in the DRESDEN-concept alliance.Reference to data protection: Your data protection rights, the purpose for which your data will be processed, as well as further information about data protection is available to you on the website: https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis (https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis) .

Building on the dynamically growing research fields of the Energy Humanities, Science & Technology Studies, and the Digital Humanities, the aim is to examine how modern energy regimes—from petromodernity, to nuclear culture, and post-carbon futures—have shaped not only material infrastructures but also subjectivities, power relations, progress narratives, geopolitical orders, ecologies, and knowledge systems, while simultaneously being shaped by them. Interdisciplinary perspectives from the social sciences, cultural studies, humanities, and educational research represented at the Schaufler Kolleg@TU Dresden enable the analysis of the multifaceted entanglements of energy, culture, and society. The focus is on questions concerning the representation, communication, and aesthetics of energy transitions and resource paradigms as well as continuities between resource economies and information economies, the relationships between energy, labor, environment, and consumer culture, and the role of colonialism, gender, nationalism, geopolitics, education, and social justice in deciding energy futures and navigating collective transformation processes. In the field of International Politics, the following research areas and questions are of particular relevance to the guiding theme:- Research on the transnational transition of energy cultures by linking Political Science and International Relations with Social Movement Studies, Sociology, or Conflict Studies- Energy transformation as a political and social distributional conflict in the context of global governance and transnational networks- Challenges of cross-border labour relations in the context of the energy transition, and as objects of analysis for Global Social Policy, Transnational Advocacy Networks, and international norm research- Analysis of legitimation strategies for international objectives (e.g., CO2 reduction) at the national and local levels, particularly in the context of labour- Investigation of global and transnational issues in local contexts, for example through the application of qualitative, comparative, and ethnographic methodsTasks:Your tasks include independent research and academic further qualification with the goal of completing a doctorate at TUD, as well as writing a dissertation on a topic within the guiding concept "Energy Cultures in Transition" in the discipline of Political Science/International Relations/Political Sociology. The fellowship requires a high degree of willingness to engage in interdisciplinary dialogue, particularly with the STEM partnerships of the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, as well as to conduct joint research with artists within the framework of the Schaufler Residency. In addition, engagement in the areas of science communication and outreach is expected. Shared office spaces will be made available to the fellows. Participation in the Kolleg's English-language training program is mandatory.Requirements:You hold an excellent university degree (Master's or equivalent) in Political Science or a comparable social science discipline. Furthermore, you have relevant prior experience in the application of social science methods as well as in the fields of International Politics and Social Movement Studies. You have a strong ability to work in teams and enjoy interdisciplinary collaboration. As the training program is conducted in English, you have English skills at a minimum of C1 level. In accordance with the doctoral regulations of the Faculty of Arts, Humanities and Social Science, the dissertation may be written in either German or English—if you choose to write it in German, corresponding German language skills are required. Beyond this, German language skills are desirable but not mandatory.We offer:The opportunity to pursue a doctorate within the Schaufler Kolleg with a structured qualification program and integration into an interdisciplinary research project. You will receive a fully equipped office workspace on the premises of TUD and access to an excellent research infrastructure, including participation in Research Studios and writing retreats. The Graduate Academy and other central institutions of TUD offer numerous further training and qualification opportunities. In addition, within the limits of the available project funds, the Schaufler Lab will cover the costs of conference travel. Inclusion and equal opportunities are important to us. We therefore look forward to receiving applications from people regardless of gender, origin, sexual orientation, worldview, or disability. TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The University is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment. The fellowship does not constitute an employment relationship.Application:Your detailed application, in German or English, should contain, in addition to the completed online application form (https://tu-dresden.de/gsw/schauflerlab/schaufler-kolleg/phase-3/anmeldung-registration) , a letter of motivation, a curriculum vitae in tabular form including an account of your academic career, a copy of your most recent university degree certificate, an exposé of your research project including a work and time schedule (max. 20,000 characters), and, where applicable, details of your family situation. Please send us your application documents, including the online application form, quoting the reference number s26-003, by November 24, 2026 (stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD applies), preferably via the TUD SecureMail Portal https://securemail.tu-dresden.de (https://securemail.tu-dresden.de/)  by sending it as a single pdf file to schaufler.lab@tu-dresden.de (https://mailto:schaufler.lab@tu-dresden.de) or to:TU Dresden, Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, Prof. Dr. Anna Holzscheiter, Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany.Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. Expenses incurred in attending interviews cannot be reimbursed.TUD is a founding partner in the DRESDEN-concept alliance.Reference to data protection: Your data protection rights, the purpose for which your data will be processed, as well as further information about data protection is available to you on the website: https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis (https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis) .

title: Strategic Procurement Manager - Semiconductor Materials (f/m/d) (Category-Manager/in)
description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Strategische/r Einkäufer/in; Technische/r Einkäufer/inStellenbeschreibung:About usWe see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects.About our technologyThe semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude.In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution.The RoleBlack Semiconductor is looking for a Strategic Procurement Manager (f/m/d) or Category Manager (f/m/d) to strengthen our growing team in Aachen, Germany. In this role, you will lead strategic sourcing and supplier management activities for materials critical to semiconductor manufacturing. You will ensure continuity of supply, optimize total cost of ownership, and maintain quality compliance while adapting to evolving technology requirements and market conditions.To join our team, you should be excited to take ownership of:- Develop and execute global sourcing strategies for semiconductor materials, including wafers, photoresists, CMP slurries, specialty gases, chemicals, and other critical materials.- Identify, qualify, and manage strategic suppliers while ensuring alignment with technology roadmaps, quality standards, and production requirements.- Negotiate contracts, pricing, and commercial terms to achieve cost targets while securing reliable supply.- Monitor semiconductor material markets, supplier performance, pricing trends, and supply chain risks to identify opportunities and mitigation strategies.- Collaborate with R&D, process engineering, quality, and manufacturing teams to align material requirements with technology and production needs.- Support new product introductions by sourcing materials that meet emerging process requirements and scalability targets.- Manage procurement performance, supplier relationships, and reporting activities to support business objectives.Your Profile- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in supply chain management, engineering, physics, materials science, business, or a related field.- 5+ years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, or supply chain management, preferably within semiconductors, electronics, or advanced manufacturing.- Proven experience negotiating contracts, managing suppliers, and driving cost optimization initiatives.- Strong understanding of semiconductor materials and processes, including wafers, specialty gases, chemicals, photoresists, lithography, etching, and metallization materials.- Strong analytical skills with experience using ERP/procurement systems and data analysis tools.- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with fluent English; German language skills are considered an advantage.- Willing to work on-site at our Aachen office at least once a week.Our work culturePeople Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what mattersLet’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal developmentYour Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and futureWe Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forwardWe connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry.Can you picture yourself in this Role and our Company? title: (Senior) Product Manager - (Logistics, Customer Choice) (Product Owner)
description: Company DescriptionAs the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.Job DescriptionWe are on the lookout for a (Senior) Product Manager in Logistics Customer Choice to own the demand management solutions that keep ordering smooth when delivery capacity is stretched. You'll work hands-on with Engineering and Data Science to turn real-time fleet saturation signals into product decisions that lift peak-time conversion and reduce cancellations. You'll be accountable for execution as much as strategy, bringing Operations, regional teams, and engineers along as features go live.We are building the Choice products that decide which options customers see, balancing real-time fleet saturation with customer intent so logistical saturation doesn't get in the way of ordering.In our Logistics Team, you'll tackle high-impact challenges that make last-mile delivery efficient, affordable, and sustainable. Your work will directly improve experiences for riders, end customers, and merchants across the globe. Each enhancement you contribute will help Delivery Hero optimize delivery operations, supporting expansion into new areas like grocery and retail.- Own the roadmap for demand management solutions that balance fleet capacity with customer ordering.- Take features from idea to launch with Engineering, writing clear requirements and prioritizing the backlog.- Partner with Data Science to shape and evaluate models and AI-driven configurations that replace manual operational settings.- Run experiments and track conversion, cancellation, and fleet saturation metrics to decide what ships next.- Align Operations, regional product teams, and engineers on priorities, trade-offs, and timelines throughout delivery.- Coordinate with multiple internal stakeholders to ensure the services we use are being consumed and to understand the end-to-end impact.Qualifications- 3-5 years of product management experience, ideally in marketplace, logistics, or e-commerce environments.- A track record of managing stakeholders through execution and aligning diverse teams on complex initiatives.- Hands-on ownership: you're comfortable working through details with engineers, including APIs and system behavior.- Comfort using data to define success measures and assess impact.- Experience working with data scientists, plus a working understanding of ML concepts and experimentation frameworks.- Ability to manage several competing priorities when operational conditions change quickly.Nice to have- Experience in logistics, delivery, or other supply-and-demand balancing problems.- Experience building internal tools for operations teams.- Exposure to rules engines, ranking, or personalization systems.- Experience launching AI-driven product features.Additional InformationEnsuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. to ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.- Build and lead a high-performing HR Technology and Digitalisation function, fostering innovation and continuous improvement.This is you:- You bring 10+ years of experience in HR Technology, Digital HR, HR Transformation or a related field within a large, complex global organisation.- You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.Other benefits depending on the location

title: Field Service Specialist
description: Location: Europe – preferably Poland, Czech Republic or Romania.DTE is a fast-growing deep-tech company transforming how the metals industry controls and optimises its production. Our real-time melt chemistry technology gives aluminium producers immediate insight into their process, unlocking operational efficiency, higher yields and more sustainable production.As DTE expands its international operations, we are looking for a Field Service Specialist based in Europe to support future customer deployments and help establish our field service capabilities in the region.This is an opportunity to join a growing international team, work hands-on with innovative industrial technology and play an important role in building DTE's presence in the European market.Position SummaryThe Field Service Specialist will be part of DTE's Service, Production and Delivery team, supporting the installation, commissioning, maintenance and troubleshooting of DTE's industrial analytical equipment as new customer deployments are established.You will work closely with customers during installation, start-up and service visits, configuring equipment to meet operational requirements, training operators and providing remote and on-site technical support.The role also involves close collaboration with DTE's Engineering and Service teams in Iceland and internationally, contributing practical field experience to product improvements and the development of service procedures.We are looking for someone who enjoys working directly with customers, understands demanding industrial environments and takes ownership of solving technical challenges.This is a hands-on technical role in demanding industrial environments involving heat, noise, dust and heavy machinery, requiring a strong commitment to safety, quality and reliable operation.Key ResponsibilitiesInstall, commission and service DTE's analytical equipment at customer sites as new deployments are established.Ensure installations and service work meet DTE's standards for quality, safety and reliability.Configure equipment, perform functional testing and train customer operators.Troubleshoot, maintain and repair equipment, providing both remote and on-site technical support.Assess customer site readiness ahead of installation, including power, utilities, access, lifting arrangements and safety requirements.Participate in an on-call rota for technical support as required.Collaborate with DTE's Engineering and Service teams to identify technical issues, implement improvements and support product development.Contribute to the development of service procedures, checklists, spare parts lists and troubleshooting documentation.Help establish and develop DTE's field service capabilities in Europe as the company expands into the region.Qualifications, Knowledge & ExperienceAt least 3 years of experience in field service, equipment assembly or technical support involving electronic or industrial equipment.A degree or vocational qualification in engineering, electronics, electrical technology or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience.Experience troubleshooting automated control systems and industrial equipment.Strong analytical and practical problem-solving skills.Ability to work independently, take initiative and manage technical challenges in the field.Comfortable working in demanding industrial environments, including foundries and aluminium production facilities.Strong commitment to safety, quality and customer service.Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.Knowledge of Polish, Czech, Romanian, German, Spanish, or other European languages is an advantage.Valid driving licence and passport.Legal authorisation to work or provide services in the country of residence.Experience in the metals industry, foundries or industrial automation, as well as electrical qualifications or certifications, would be an advantage.Location & TravelEmployment Type: We are open to both direct employment and independent contractor arrangements, depending on the candidate's location, experience and the most suitable contractual setup.Location: Preferably Poland, Czech Republic or Romania. This is a home-based field service position field service position, requiring regular international travel to support customer deployments, installations, training and technical service activities. The role is expected to involve approximately 50% travel, depending on project schedules and customer requirements. Travel will support DTE's international operations and future customer deployments in Europe, with visits to DTE headquarters in Iceland for training, product familiarisation and collaboration with Engineering and other teams.The successful candidate should live within convenient driving distance of a major international airport.For applications & inquiries send to: agusta@dte.aiLast application date is October 31st, 2026.Why DTE?We are past proving that the technology works. DTE's systems are already operating in production environments, and we are now scaling from individual installations to plant-wide deployments.We are solving a fundamental blind spot in one of the world's largest industries: metals producers cannot optimise what they cannot measure in real time.Our technology provides the foundation for real-time process control, higher recycling rates, lower emissions and the future of autonomous metals manufacturing.As we expand into Europe, you will have the opportunity to help build our regional service capabilities from the ground up, while working closely with an experienced international team.Our core values are purpose, excellence and empowerment. We look for people who are driven, resilient and motivated by building technology with real industrial impact.We encourage people of all genders to apply. DTE is committed to being an inclusive workplace where employees feel empowered, supported and able to do their best work. We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Assistant driller
description: Seeking an assistant drillerIceland Drilling Company (IDC) is an international leader in geothermal drilling, committed to providing safe and efficient drilling solutions with a focus on sustainability. We take pride in operating advanced, automatic drilling rigs that create a safe and positive working environment for our highly motivated crew members.Key Responsibilities:• Responsibility for correct mud tank settings, mixing mud and mud additives, measurement of specific gravity and viscosity of mud, monitior and cleaning mud pumps and pits.• Trip in – lubricating threads and assisting with drill string assembly and removal of drill string.• Receipt, measurement and cleaning of casings, assisting with casing assembly.• Installation and arrangement of BOP‘s.• Assisting with cementing.• Reception and clearing up of drilling equipment (drill bits, stabilizers, jars, mud motors, MWD‘s etc).• Substitute for driller/assistant driller as needed.Qualifications & Requirements:• Experience within geothermal drilling is preferred. Experience with Drillmec or Bentec rigs strongly preferred. Experince as Derrickman. 2 years minimum Assistant Driller experience highly preferred.• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong problem-solving and initiative, fluency in English. Good experince operating powertools.• Valid driver's license. Icelandic forklift license (preferred). IWCF license, level 1-2 preferred. Forklift license for 10 tons + preferred.• Proactive approach to hazard identification and control. Ability to work effectively in remote and demanding environments. Ability to work under pressure and in challenging environments.• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make quick decisions.• Safety-conscious with a commitment to maintaining high safety standard.Employer can assist with housing.Full time job – shift work; work arrangements vary depending on the project.Wages according to collective agreements with Framsýn workers union.Please apply by sending your application and CV to: jons@jardboranir.is.Last application date is October 31, 2026.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description: **Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi - nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia - saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun - vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;- toiminta uusiin maihin - markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille - elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiäYhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍK
description: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍKAre you ready to make your mark on one of Iceland’s most exciting culinary destinations?We are seeking a creative and ambitious Head Chef for a well-established fine dining restaurant in Reykjavík. Selected by the MICHELIN Guide, the restaurant offers contemporary Icelandic cuisine with strong roots in the country’s culinary heritage.This is a rare opportunity to lead a dedicated kitchen team, develop your own culinary direction and work with some of the Nordic region’s most distinctive ingredients.ABOUT THE RESTAURANTThe restaurant serves modern Icelandic cuisine, with seasonality, sustainability and local ingredients at its heart. The menus evolve with the seasons, showcasing the best Iceland has to offer—from fish, shellfish and lamb to wild herbs, seaweed and produce from local suppliers.The restaurant has recently moved to new premises with a larger, upgraded kitchen. The incoming Head Chef will have considerable creative freedom to develop the menus and help shape the restaurant’s future culinary direction.THE ROLEAs Head Chef, you will have overall responsibility for the kitchen’s culinary direction and operations. You will lead the team in its daily work, ensuring consistently exceptional standards throughout every service.Your responsibilities will include:    Leading, developing and motivating the kitchen team    Creating seasonal menus    Maintaining quality and consistency throughout every service    Establishing clear planning, structure and efficient kitchen workflows    Working closely with local, sustainably sourced ingredients    Further developing the restaurant’s identity and culinary direction    Creating a professional, safe and inclusive kitchen cultureWHO WE ARE LOOKING FORWe are looking for a creative, ambitious chef who is confident in a professional kitchen. You have a strong fine dining background and understand the precision, quality and attention to the overall guest experience expected at MICHELIN Guide level.You may already be working as a Head Chef, or you may be an outstanding Sous Chef ready to take the next step into a leadership role.We believe you bring:    Substantial experience in fine dining or another high-level culinary environment    Experience in menu development and working with seasonal ingredients    A clear, hands-on leadership style    The ability to bring structure, quality and a positive working atmosphere to the kitchen    A genuine interest in sustainability and local ingredients    The ability to balance creativity with quality, financial discipline and reliable operations    Strong communication skills in an international working environmentExperience at a Michelin restaurant or an equivalent culinary level is an advantage, but potential, leadership and ambition can be equally important.A KITCHEN WITH A STRONG TRADITION OF WOMEN IN GASTRONOMYFor the past ten years, the restaurant’s kitchen has been staffed by an all-female team. The restaurant is deeply committed to supporting women in gastronomy and creating opportunities for female chefs to develop into leaders.We want to continue building a workplace where women can grow, make an impact and take on culinary leadership roles. We welcome qualified applicants of all genders and select candidates based on their skills, leadership, motivation and potential.WHAT’S ON OFFER    A key leadership role at a restaurant recommended by the MICHELIN Guide    Considerable creative freedom to shape the menus and culinary direction    A larger, recently upgraded restaurant kitchen    Access to unique Icelandic ingredients and local producers    The opportunity to lead and develop an ambitious kitchen team    An international career opportunity in Reykjavík    Accommodation options, discussed individually    Salary, start date and other terms by agreementABOUT REYKJAVÍKReykjavík offers a rare combination of urban creativity, a vibrant restaurant scene and spectacular natural surroundings. The sea, mountains, hot springs and some of the Nordic region’s most exciting ingredients are all close at hand.For the right person, this is more than a new job. It is an opportunity to create something of your own while discovering a new country, a new food culture and a new way of life.HOW TO APPLYThe recruitment process is managed by Wildcard Untap, which helps hospitality businesses find skilled specialists and leaders through proactive search, personal dialogue and professional judgement.Please send your CV and a brief introduction outlining your experience, leadership approach and culinary philosophy to:jobb@wildcarduntap.comPlease use the subject line: “Head Chef – Reykjavík”Applications will be reviewed and interviews held on an ongoing basis. All applications will be treated confidentially.

title: HEADCHEF TILL MICHELIN GUIDE-REKOMMENDERAD RESTAURANG I REYKJAVÍK
description: Är du redo att sätta din egen prägel på en av Islands mest spännande gastronomiska destinationer?Nu söker vi en kreativ och ambitiös Head Chef till en välrenommerad fine dining-restaurang i Reykjavík. Restaurangen är utvald av MICHELIN Guide (2026) och erbjuder samtida isländsk gastronomi med tydliga rötter i landets matkultur.Det här är en sällsynt möjlighet för dig som vill leda ett engagerat köksteam, utveckla en egen kulinarisk riktning och arbeta nära några av Nordens mest särpräglade råvaror.OM RESTAURANGENRestaurangen arbetar med modern isländsk matlagning där säsong, hållbarhet och lokala råvaror står i centrum. Menyerna följer årstiderna och bygger på det bästa som Island har att erbjuda – från fisk, skaldjur och lamm till vilda örter, tång och råvaror från lokala producenter.Verksamheten har nyligen flyttat till nya lokaler med ett större och uppgraderat kök. Den nya kökschefen får därför stor kreativ frihet att utveckla menyerna och vara med och forma restaurangens framtida gastronomiska inriktning.ROLLENSom Head Chef får du det övergripande kulinariska och operativa ansvaret för köket. Du leder teamet i den dagliga driften och säkerställer att varje servering håller en jämn och mycket hög nivå.Rollen omfattar bland annat:    Ledning, utveckling och motivation av köksteamet    Utveckling av säsongsbaserade menyer    Kvalitetssäkring och konsekvent nivå i varje servering    Planering, struktur och ett effektivt arbetsflöde i köket    Nära arbete med lokala och hållbara råvaror    Att vidareutveckla restaurangens identitet och gastronomiska riktning    Att skapa en professionell, trygg och inkluderande kökskulturVEM SÖKER VI?Vi söker dig som är kreativ, ambitiös och trygg i ett professionellt kök. Du har en stark bakgrund inom fine dining och förstår de krav på precision, kvalitet och helhetsupplevelse som ställs på MICHELIN Guide-nivå.Du kan redan arbeta som Head Chef, men vi välkomnar även en mycket skicklig Sous Chef som är redo att ta nästa steg in i en ledande roll.Vi tror att du har:    Gedigen erfarenhet från fine dining eller annan gastronomisk verksamhet på hög nivå    Erfarenhet av menyutveckling och arbete med säsongsbaserade råvaror    Ett tydligt och närvarande ledarskap    Förmåga att skapa struktur, kvalitet och arbetsglädje i köket    Ett genuint intresse för hållbarhet och lokala råvaror    Förmåga att kombinera kreativitet med kvalitet, ekonomi och stabil drift    God kommunikativ förmåga i en internationell arbetsmiljöErfarenhet från en Michelin-restaurang eller motsvarande gastronomisk nivå är meriterande, men rätt potential, ledarskap och ambition kan vara lika viktigt.ETT KÖK MED EN STARK KVINNLIG TRADITIONUnder de senaste tio åren har restaurangens kök bestått av ett kvinnligt team. Verksamheten har ett starkt engagemang för att stödja kvinnor inom gastronomin och skapa möjligheter för kvinnliga kockar att utvecklas till ledare.Vi vill fortsätta bygga en arbetsplats där kvinnor kan växa, påverka och ta plats i gastronomiska ledarroller. Samtidigt välkomnar vi kvalificerade sökande oavsett kön och gör urvalet utifrån kompetens, ledarskap, motivation och potential.DET HÄR ERBJUDS    En central ledarroll på en MICHELIN Guide-rekommenderad restaurang    Stor kreativ frihet att påverka menyer och gastronomisk inriktning    Ett större och nyligen uppgraderat restaurangkök    Tillgång till unika isländska råvaror och lokala producenter    Möjlighet att leda och utveckla ett ambitiöst köksteam    En internationell karriärmöjlighet i Reykjavík    Boendemöjligheter finns och diskuteras individuellt    Lön, startdatum och övriga villkor enligt överenskommelseOM REYKJAVÍKReykjavík erbjuder en ovanlig kombination av kreativ storstad, levande restaurangkultur och storslagen natur. Här finns havet, bergen, varma källor och några av Nordens mest intressanta råvaror alldeles i närheten.För rätt person är detta mer än ett nytt arbete. Det är möjligheten att skapa något eget och samtidigt uppleva ett nytt land, en ny matkultur och en ny vardag.ANSÖKANRekryteringen genomförs av Wildcard Untap, som hjälper verksamheter inom hotell och restaurang att hitta kvalificerade specialister och ledare genom aktiv search, personlig dialog och professionellt omdöme.Skicka CV och en kort presentation av din erfarenhet, ditt ledarskap och din gastronomiska filosofi till:jobb@wildcarduntap.comMärk ansökan: ”Head Chef – Reykjavík”Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Alla ansökningar behandlas konfidentiellt.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description: **Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi - nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia - saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun - vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;- toiminta uusiin maihin - markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille - elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiäYhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.Odotan yhteydenottoasi!
