Möguleiki á að framlengja starfið í a.m.k. 1 ár eða til framtíðar.Helstu verkefni:Snyrting og skurður: Skera burt blóðhorf, galla eða dregna orma úr flökum.Pökkun: Raða flökum, bitum eða öðrum afurðum í öskjur, plast eða kassa.Flokkun: Flokka fisk eftir stærð, gæðum og tegundum.Vélavinna: Starfa við flökunarvélar, Hausunarvélar eða aðrar vélar tengdar fiskvinnsluÞrif og hreinlæti: Þrífa vinnusvæði og tæki samkvæmt ströngum hreinlætiskröfum.Vinnuumhverfi og kröfur:Húsnæði: Unnið er innanhúss í köldu og röku umhverfi (oftast um 4–12°C til að vernda vöruna).Vinnuföt: Starfsfólk fær sérstakan hlífðarfatnað (stígvél, svuntur, hanska, hárnet).Líkamlegt erfiði: Starfið krefst þess að standa lengi í einu og gera endurteknar hreyfingar.Kröfur: Ekki er krafist sérstakrar menntunar en góð sjón, nákvæmni og þol eru mikilvægir eiginleikar.Æskilegt að viðkomandi tali íslensku, ensku eða pólsku.Aðstoð er veitt við að útvega húsnæði á svæðinu. Vinsamlegast sendið umsókn ásamt ferilskrá á netfangið: AL@kg.isUmsóknarfrestur er til og með 1. nóvember 2026.----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------KG Fiskverkun in Rif is seeking to hire a Production worker for general duties in saltfish processing.Full-time position.Working hours from 07:55-16:00 (30-minute lunch break).Occasional overtime may be required, in which case working hours may be extended until 18:00.Salary is paid in accordance with applicable collective agreements, in addition to both a fixed bonus and an attendance-related bonus.This is a temporary position until June 30, 2027, with the possibility of an extension for at least one year or potentially a permanent position.Key Responsibilities:Trimming and Cutting: Removing blood spots, defects, or parasites from fish fillets.Packing: Arranging fillets, portions, and other products into boxes, plastic packaging, or containers.Sorting: Classifying fish according to size, quality, and species.Machine Operation: Working with filleting machines, heading machines, and other equipment used in fish processing.Cleaning and Sanitation: Maintaining workstations and equipment in accordance with strict hygiene standards.Working Environment and Requirements:Work Environment: Indoor work in a cold and humid environment (typically between 4°C and 12°C to preserve product quality).Protective Clothing: Employees are provided with protective workwear, including boots, aprons, gloves, and hairnets.Physical Demands: The position requires standing for extended periods and performing repetitive tasks.Qualifications: No formal education is required; however, good eyesight, attention to detail, reliability, and physical stamina are important qualities.Language Skills: Applicants should preferably speak Icelandic, English, or Polish.Assistance with finding housing is provided. Please send your application and CV to: AL@kg.isApplication deadline: November 1st, 2026.

title: Kokkur – víetnömsk matargerð / Chef - Vietnamese Cuisine
description: Down Town ehf. óskar eftir að ráða einn kokk með reynslu af víetnamskri matargerð í ótímabundið 100% starf á Arnarstapa.Helstu verkefni:* Matreiðsla og undirbúningur víetnamskra rétta.* Þátttaka í uppsetningu, skipulagningu og undirbúningi eldhúss fyrir opnun staðarins.* Undirbúningur hráefna og skipulagning daglegrar framleiðslu.* Þróun og samræming matseðils.* Eftirlit með gæðum, skammtastærðum og framsetningu rétta.* Frágangur og þrif ásamt því að fylgja reglum um hreinlæti og matvælaöryggi.* Samvinna við annað starfsfólk og önnur almenn störf í eldhúsi.Hæfniskröfur:* Sannanleg reynsla af matreiðslu víetnamskra rétta.* Reynsla af starfi í atvinnueldhúsi.* Þekking á hreinlæti og matvælaöryggi.* Hæfni til að vinna sjálfstætt og í samstarfi við aðra.* Stundvísi, áreiðanleiki og góð vinnubrögð.* Umsækjandi þarf að geta átt samskipti á íslensku eða ensku.* Formleg menntun í matreiðslu er kostur en ekki skilyrði.Starfið er 40 klukkustundir á viku og unnið er á vöktum samkvæmt vaktaskrá. Ef atvinnuleyfis er krafist getur viðkomandi ekki hafið störf fyrr en leyfið hefur verið veitt.Umsækjendur skulu senda ferilskrá, upplýsingar um starfsreynslu og meðmæli, ef þau liggja fyrir, á winehf@gmail.com.------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Down Town ehf. is seeking to hire one Chef with experience in Vietnamese cuisine for a permanent full-time position (100%) in Arnarstapi, Iceland.Key Responsibilities:Prepare and cook Vietnamese dishes.Participate in the setup, organization, and preparation of the kitchen prior to the opening of the establishment.Prepare ingredients and organize daily food production.Assist in menu development and standardization.Monitor food quality, portion sizes, and presentation standards.Carry out cleaning duties and ensure compliance with hygiene and food safety regulations.Work collaboratively with other staff members and perform general kitchen duties as required.Qualifications:Proven experience preparing Vietnamese cuisine.Previous experience working in a professional kitchen.Knowledge of hygiene and food safety practices.Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.Punctual, reliable, and able to maintain high work standards.Ability to communicate in either Icelandic or English.Formal culinary education is an advantage but not a requirement.Working Hours: This is a full-time position (40 hours per week). Work is performed according to a shift schedule and may include day, evening, and weekend shifts.The base salary is ISK 680,000 per month for a full-time position, in addition to shift differentials, overtime pay, and other payments in accordance with the collective agreement between the SGS and SA for restaurants, accommodation providers, service establishments, entertainment companies, and related activities for the period 2024-2028.The preferred start date is as soon as possible, by mutual agreement and following the completion of the recruitment process.If a work permit is required, employment cannot commence until the permit has been granted.Applicants are requested to submit a CV, details of relevant work experience, and references (if available) to: winehf@gmail.comApplicants will be considered on the basis of their qualifications, experience, and suitability for the position.

title: Field Service Specialist
description: Location: Europe – preferably Poland, Czech Republic or Romania.DTE is a fast-growing deep-tech company transforming how the metals industry controls and optimises its production. Our real-time melt chemistry technology gives aluminium producers immediate insight into their process, unlocking operational efficiency, higher yields and more sustainable production.As DTE expands its international operations, we are looking for a Field Service Specialist based in Europe to support future customer deployments and help establish our field service capabilities in the region.This is an opportunity to join a growing international team, work hands-on with innovative industrial technology and play an important role in building DTE's presence in the European market.Position SummaryThe Field Service Specialist will be part of DTE's Service, Production and Delivery team, supporting the installation, commissioning, maintenance and troubleshooting of DTE's industrial analytical equipment as new customer deployments are established.You will work closely with customers during installation, start-up and service visits, configuring equipment to meet operational requirements, training operators and providing remote and on-site technical support.The role also involves close collaboration with DTE's Engineering and Service teams in Iceland and internationally, contributing practical field experience to product improvements and the development of service procedures.We are looking for someone who enjoys working directly with customers, understands demanding industrial environments and takes ownership of solving technical challenges.This is a hands-on technical role in demanding industrial environments involving heat, noise, dust and heavy machinery, requiring a strong commitment to safety, quality and reliable operation.Key ResponsibilitiesInstall, commission and service DTE's analytical equipment at customer sites as new deployments are established.Ensure installations and service work meet DTE's standards for quality, safety and reliability.Configure equipment, perform functional testing and train customer operators.Troubleshoot, maintain and repair equipment, providing both remote and on-site technical support.Assess customer site readiness ahead of installation, including power, utilities, access, lifting arrangements and safety requirements.Participate in an on-call rota for technical support as required.Collaborate with DTE's Engineering and Service teams to identify technical issues, implement improvements and support product development.Contribute to the development of service procedures, checklists, spare parts lists and troubleshooting documentation.Help establish and develop DTE's field service capabilities in Europe as the company expands into the region.Qualifications, Knowledge & ExperienceAt least 3 years of experience in field service, equipment assembly or technical support involving electronic or industrial equipment.A degree or vocational qualification in engineering, electronics, electrical technology or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience.Experience troubleshooting automated control systems and industrial equipment.Strong analytical and practical problem-solving skills.Ability to work independently, take initiative and manage technical challenges in the field.Comfortable working in demanding industrial environments, including foundries and aluminium production facilities.Strong commitment to safety, quality and customer service.Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.Knowledge of Polish, Czech, Romanian, German, Spanish, or other European languages is an advantage.Valid driving licence and passport.Legal authorisation to work or provide services in the country of residence.Experience in the metals industry, foundries or industrial automation, as well as electrical qualifications or certifications, would be an advantage.Location & TravelEmployment Type: We are open to both direct employment and independent contractor arrangements, depending on the candidate's location, experience and the most suitable contractual setup.Location: Preferably Poland, Czech Republic or Romania. This is a home-based field service position field service position, requiring regular international travel to support customer deployments, installations, training and technical service activities. The role is expected to involve approximately 50% travel, depending on project schedules and customer requirements. Travel will support DTE's international operations and future customer deployments in Europe, with visits to DTE headquarters in Iceland for training, product familiarisation and collaboration with Engineering and other teams.The successful candidate should live within convenient driving distance of a major international airport.For applications & inquiries send to: agusta@dte.aiLast application date is October 31st, 2026.Why DTE?We are past proving that the technology works. DTE's systems are already operating in production environments, and we are now scaling from individual installations to plant-wide deployments.We are solving a fundamental blind spot in one of the world's largest industries: metals producers cannot optimise what they cannot measure in real time.Our technology provides the foundation for real-time process control, higher recycling rates, lower emissions and the future of autonomous metals manufacturing.As we expand into Europe, you will have the opportunity to help build our regional service capabilities from the ground up, while working closely with an experienced international team.Our core values are purpose, excellence and empowerment. We look for people who are driven, resilient and motivated by building technology with real industrial impact.We encourage people of all genders to apply. DTE is committed to being an inclusive workplace where employees feel empowered, supported and able to do their best work. We look forward to receiving your application.

Esperienza commerciale / business development nella vendita B2B di almeno uno tra: capacità satellitare, air-time, connettività satellitare gestita, servizi satellite IoT, terminali satellitari, backhaul satellitare, soluzioni satcom per clienti industriali. Conoscenza concreta della filiera satcom: operatori, capacità, segmenti di terra, terminali, gateway, provisioning, SLA, supporto e modelli di distribuzione. Esperienza nella negoziazione di accordi wholesale, distribuzione, white-label, rivendita o managed connectivity in ambito satellitare. Seniority coerente con responsabilità autonome su partner, mercato, pipeline commerciale o risultati economici. Disponibilità a contribuire alla costruzione della società come co-founder operativo. Familiarità con modelli GEO/MEO/LEO, servizi MSS, satellite IoT, NTN, VSAT o connettività in aree remote. title: Sr Manager, EU Next Day Speed , EU Speed and Service Programs (m/f)
description: Sr Manager, EU Next Day Speed , EU Speed and Service ProgramsJob ID: 10579605 | Amazon EU SarlDescription**THIS ROLE CAN BE BASED IN LUXEMBOURG, LONDON, MUNICH, PARIS, MILAN, MADRID, BERLIN, BARCELONA**Have you ever ordered a product on Amazon and wondered how it got delivered to you so fast, and what systems and processes power the whole operation? If so, this role is for you.The EU Speed team is part of EU Supply Chain, Transportation Planning & Operational Excellence (STEP) organisation, which optimises the EU end-to-end transportation and transfer network.Our mission: offer the right speed, for the right customer, on the right selection, in the most cost-efficient manner.• Operations is at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. Each action we undertake is on behalf of our customers, as surpassing their expectations is our passion.• We improve customer experience through continuously optimising the complex movements of goods from vendors to customers throughout Europe.• We tackle Amazon's most complex problems, processes, and decisions. We work with fulfilment centers, transportation capacity, topology, connectivity, DEA, finance, and retail teams across EU to improve our logistic infrastructure and algorithms.• We are obsessed with rethinking our advanced end-to-end supply chain to make our deliveries even faster. Our overall mission: we want Amazon to be the place where customers come to get goods delivered next-day.Key job responsibilitiesWe are seeking a Sr. Manager to own the end-to-end strategy, execution, and performance of 1D+ Speed across EU5 and EXP8 markets. This is high-visibility leadership role accountable for speed outcomes that impact day to day our customers.Our overall mission is simple: we want Amazon to be the place where customers come to get goods delivered next-day. This role is the senior leader who makes that happen. You will own end-to-end Next Day speed to improve customer experience across EU markets. The problem space is broad, the opportunity is not fully defined, and the strategy is yours to set. This is a people manager role: you will lead a team of Program managers and Analyst, while personally driving the multi-year vision and roadmap for Next Day speed improvement. You will distill diverse inputs from large customer segments and cross-functional stakeholders to design and drive the right long-term solution. You will own the Speed metric for 1D and 2D Speed, setting targets, identifying structural headwinds and tailwinds, and driving the cross-functional mechanisms required to close gaps at country and EU level. You deliver with independence and high judgment, distinguishing between one-way and two-way doors to move fast where appropriate and exercise caution where the stakes demand it.A day in the lifeThis role requires you to:• Set the vision and own the strategy for Next Day Speed: The problem, opportunity, and strategy are often not predefined: you identify them, frame them, and drive the organization toward the right outcome. You own Next Day Glance View Speed and are accountable for translating strategic ambiguity into a clear, executable plan.• Lead across significantly complex, persistent programs: Own a portfolio of speed initiatives spanning multiple orgs and countries. Handle significantly complex problems, decisions, and escalations where the methodology, requirements, customer needs, and technical feasibility may not be defined. Deconstruct risks into appropriate simplicity and make trade-offs between opportunity, resources, and sustainability.• Drive organisational influence at scale: Influence team priorities and business strategy across STEP Operations, Transportation, Network Design, Finance, Stores, and country-level operations. Partner at Director/VP level to align capacity, investment, and operational priorities with speed targets. You effectively force-multiply by working across your org to shape priorities and goals through data-driven contributions.• Build and lead mechanisms for operational excellence: create scalable mechanisms and best practices, and educate others on them. Actively remove bottlenecks and set the standard for process improvement.• Communicate at the highest level: Author high-quality narratives that distill complex operational data into clear, actionable insights. You are trusted to present decisions to leaders two levels above you. You ask the hard questions, decompose significantly complex problems into straightforward solutions, build consensus, and align teams toward coherent strategies across locales, roles, and functions.• Build and develop future leaders (people manager): Hire, mentor, and grow a team of program managers and analysts. Develop future leaders and participate actively in the recruitment process. Lead by example, encouraging positive and constructive feedback in doc reviews, peer reviews, and cross-team evaluations.• Innovate and simplify: Identify structural opportunities to improve speed at lower cost. Challenge existing assumptions, propose new approaches, and build scalable mechanisms that reduce manual effort and increase speed predictability. You acquire new knowledge and skills as needed to solve problems that do not have established playbooks.About the teamThis role demands two mindsets that set exceptional leaders apart:• Grit: You have a clear goal and the relentless ability to move toward it despite roadblocks and challenges. When a speed target is at risk, you do not wait for conditions to improve: you find the path, rally the teams, and deliver the outcome.• Lateral thinking: You challenge the status quo, think out of the box, and adopt a diverse and often bold approach to problem solving. You are the visible, vocal owner of >1D speed.Your work is strategic, and you are the primary owner. You do not wait for problems to be handed to you: you identify them, frame the right question, and drive the organization to the answer. Basic Qualifications- Bachelor's degree in Business, Logistics, Business Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field- Experience leading and interacting with cross-functional teams- Experience managing large data sets and utilizing to drive performance and process improvements- Experience in stakeholder and communication managementPreferred Qualifications- Master's degree

title: Decarbonisation & Energy Transition Advisor (H/F)
description: LA CHAMBRE DE COMMERCE SE PROPOSE D'ENGAGER POUR LA HOUSE OF SUSTAINABILITY : Decarbonisation & Energy Transition Advisorà temps plein et à durée indéterminée La Chambre de Commerce est l'institution phare des entreprises et de l'économie du Luxembourg, regroupant l'ensemble des entreprises luxembourgeoises exerçant des activités industrielles, commerciales, financier/ières, de services et émanant du secteur de l'Horeca. Elle représente aujourd'hui quelques . entreprises, intervenant à raison de % dans le PIB luxembourgeois et occupant % du total de l'emploi salarié.La promotion de l'entrepreneuriat et de l'esprit d'entreprise, le soutien au développement et à l'internationalisation des entreprises, le développement de la formation professionnelle initiale et continue ou encore la promotion d'un cadre législatif et réglementaire propice au développement économique constituent quelques missions légales clés de cet établissement public au service des entreprises et de l'économie. La House of Sustainability est une initiative de la Chambre de Commerce visant à soutenir et à faciliter la transition durable des entreprises luxembourgeoises. Elle informe, sensibilise et accompagne les entreprises sur les enjeux de durabilité au moyen d'une offre de services dédiée. Celle-ci comprend notamment des événements, des ressources, des formations, des programmes d'accompagnement et des aides financier/ières. Au-delà de sa propre offre, la House of Sustainability constitue également un premier point de contact sur les questions de durabilité et oriente les entreprises vers les initiatives et les acteurs pertinents de l'écosystème. Au sein de la House of Sustainability de la Chambre de Commerce, le Decarbonisation & Energy Transition Advisor accompagne les entreprises ressortissant/antes dans leurs démarches de décarbonation et de transition énergétique, dans le cadre du programme Klimapakt fir Betriber (KPB).En tant que point de contact privilégié, il/elle sensibilise les entreprises aux enjeux et opportunités liés à la décarbonation et la transition énergétique. Il/elle fournit un conseil de premier niveau, identifie les besoins et les potentiels d'amélioration, et aide les entreprises à prioriser des mesures adaptées à leur situation. French and/or German would be considered a strong asset. Any additional language will be viewed favourably.You possess excellent knowledge of:• AIFMD and the Luxembourg regulatory framework applicable to investment funds.• The role and responsibilities of a Depositary Bank.• Alternative asset classes, including Private Equity, Private Debt, Real Estate and Infrastructure.• Operational risk assessment, monitoring and process enhancement.• The key drivers, developments and trends shaping the European fund industry.You have a strong understanding of:• Banking organisations, operational workflows and risk management frameworks.• Financial products and services, including cash and treasury management, securities services, financing and capital markets solutions.• Microsoft Office applications.The following would be considered a strong asset:• Experience within an AIF Depositary function, particularly in investment restriction controls.• Professional certifications in audit, internal control and/or risk management.Personal competencies:• Strong team player with an entrepreneurial mindset and a collaborative, supportive attitude.• Excellent presentation, interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal.• Strong analytical capabilities combined with conceptual and strategic thinking.• Well-organised and results-driven, with the ability to deliver high-quality work within deadlines and effectively manage priorities.• Accurate, flexible and hands-on, with the ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced environment and under tight deadlines.BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all. pour la téléphonie opérée par DEEP, assurer le suivi technique et les éléments réseau internes.• Maintenir les inventaires, schémas, procédures, dossiers d'exploitation et plans de reprise.• Participer aux projets d'évolution, de renouvellement et de sécurisation des infrastructures.Profil recherché• Vous disposez idéalement d'au moins huit années d'expérience dans l'administration d'infrastructures, de systèmes et de réseaux.• Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation supérieure en informatique ou disposez d'une expérience professionnelle équivalente.• Vous possédez une solide expérience de Windows Server, Active Directory et Linux.• Vous maîtrisez les réseaux d'entreprise, le switching, le routage, les VLAN, le Wi-Fi, les VPN et les pare-feu.• Vous connaissez la virtualisation, le stockage, la sauvegarde, la réplication et la reprise après sinistre.• Vous êtes familiarisé avec la cybersécurité, le durcissement, la gestion des vulnérabilités et l'analyse de journaux.• Vous savez diagnostiquer des incidents complexes et rédiger une documentation technique claire.• Vous disposez d'un permis de conduire et pouvez vous déplacer entre les sites.• Vous êtes disponible ponctuellement pour des interventions hors des heures habituelles.Langues• La maîtrise professionnelle de l'anglais est indispensable, notamment pour la documentation et les échanges techniques.• Le français est la langue principalement utilisée au quotidien ; une bonne maîtrise professionnelle est attendue.• La connaissance du luxembourgeois et/ou de l'allemand constitue un avantage.Qualités attendues• Autonomie, fiabilité et sens des responsabilités.• Méthode, rigueur et respect des procédures de changement et de sécurité.• Esprit d'analyse, capacité à prioriser et orientation vers la résolution de problèmes.• Esprit d'équipe, partage des connaissances et collaboration avec l'apprenti, les utilisateurs et les prestataires.• Communication claire, sens du service et discrétion.Atouts supplémentaires• Expérience de Nutanix AHV/Prism ou d'une plateforme comparable.• Connaissance de Microsoft 365, Entra ID, des environnements hybrides et de l'administration Azure.• Maîtrise de PowerShell, Bash ou d'outils d'automatisation.• Compétences en développement, notamment C#/.NET, Go, SQL ou API REST, sans que le développement soit une mission principale.• Expérience de Git, Azure DevOps, de l'Infrastructure as Code ou de pipelines d'automatisation.• Connaissance d'outils de supervision, de SIEM, de gestion des vulnérabilités et d'inventaire.Candidature:  Les candidatures, accompagnées d'un curriculum vitae, d'une lettre de motivation, les copies de vos diplômes et certificats, sont à adresser au Service des ressources humaines à jobs@csl.lu avant le 06/11/2026.Élément InformationLieu de travail Luxembourg-VilleType de contrat Contrat à durée indéterminée (CDI), à temps pleinDocuments à joindre Curriculum vitae et lettre de motivation, les copies de vos diplômes et certificatsCandidature Service des ressources humaines — jobs@csl.luInformaticien – Infrastructure, systèmes et réseaux / • CDI à temps plein • Luxembourg-VilleRejoignez la CSLLa Chambre des salariés recrute un Informaticien – Infrastructure, systèmes et réseaux. You will join a bilingual team of IT Security and Identity and Access Management Officers. In other words, you strive to bring fresh ideas to life and embrace challenges in a fast changing and complex environment. exposure to Git, Azure Pipelines or scripting is an advantage. • Analytical judgement, with the ability to identify material issues, challenge assumptions and turn complex requirements into prioritised actions. • Clear and persuasive communication, with effective stakeholder management across technical teams, control functions and senior management. • A structured, pragmatic and results-oriented approach, combined with accountability and the confidence to challenge constructively. • Curiosity about emerging threats and technologies, with the ability to learn quickly and adapt priorities in a changing environment. • Fluent written and spoken English is required. title: Sotfware Development Lead (m/f)
description: Description de tâches:Sotfware Development LeadBDO Luxembourg is looking for a Software Development Lead!Who are we?BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing.At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships.With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees.Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility, define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that supports professional development and fosters inclusivity.As Software Development Lead, you will lead take the lead on the development of internal tools and applications that bring IT closer to the business and strengthen our relationship with it. You will set the technical direction, organise the team's work and remain hands-on, delivering business applications, integrations and solutions (with or without AI) that address concrete needs across Audit, Tax, Advisory and support functions. You will take a pragmatic approach: for every need, you will look for the best solution in terms of return on investment, which is not always a full custom development, and work with product owners where a configurable or low-code platform is the right answer. Custom development relies mainly on .NET/C# and modern JavaScript frameworks (React or Angular). You will make AI an integral part of the team's daily workflow, so that it delivers quickly without compromising quality, security or maintainability.Responsibilities Team leadership• Lead, coach and develop the Software Development team: organise priorities and workload, run code reviews and support each team member's growth.• Build a balanced team of complementary profiles (full-stack developers, each with a specialty such as back-end, front-end or AI), so that knowledge is shared and no solution depends on a single person.• Define and apply team standards: coding guidelines, documentation, testing, source control and release management.• Take part in recruitment and onboarding, including team members who may be based in other locations such as Marrakech.Solution design and delivery• Work directly with business teams and product owners to understand their needs, challenge them and turn them into simple, effective solutions.• For each use case, choose the best solution in terms of return on investment: configure an existing platform, use a low-code/no-code or AI-agent approach where it fits (often together with product owners), or develop custom software when it brings real value.• Support product owners and business teams who use low-code/no-code platforms (e.g. Microsoft Power Platform): provide technical guidance and review, and help govern their use across the firm.• Design, develop and maintain custom applications, APIs and integrations using .NET/C#, React and Angular.• Build rapid prototypes and proofs of concept to validate value and feasibility before industrialising a solution.AI and modern engineering• Integrate AI capabilities into applications and business processes: large language models, agents, tool calling, RAG, MCP servers and document processing.• Make AI-assisted development the team's standard way of working (coding agents, AI-assisted design, testing, code review and documentation), with clear rules to guarantee quality.• Keep up with developments in AI and software engineering and propose relevant improvements to tools and practices.Quality, security and operations• Implement DevOps practices: CI/CD, automated testing, environment management, monitoring and logging, mainly within Microsoft Azure. Define the standards (environments, pipelines, deployment, monitoring) together with the Infrastructure team.• Apply security, data protection, access management and responsible AI principles throughout the solution lifecycle, in close collaboration with Security, Infrastructure and the DPO.• Ensure that solutions are documented, supportable and maintainable over time. Must-have requirements• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.• At least 8 years of experience in software development, including at least 2 years leading a development team or acting as technical lead.• Pragmatic mindset: the ability to compare the options (configure, buy, build) on return on investment and to choose the right one, without defaulting to full custom development or to low-code.• Solid development skills in C#/.NET and with modern front-end frameworks such as React or Angular (TypeScript).• Good knowledge of SQL databases, REST APIs and integration patterns.• Proven daily use of AI coding assistants or agents beyond code completion: solution design, implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring and documentation.• Good understanding of generative AI concepts: prompt engineering, tool calling, embeddings, RAG and AI agents.• Experience with DevOps practices: Git, CI/CD, automated testing, secrets management and monitoring, and with working alongside infrastructure teams to define shared standards.• Strong communication skills with business stakeholders and the ability to explain technical choices simply.• Fluency in English; French is a strong asset. Nice-to-have• Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g. Microsoft Power Platform), ideally in collaboration with product owners.• Experience with Microsoft Azure (App Service, Functions, Container Apps) and Azure AI services (Azure OpenAI, AI Foundry, AI Search).• Experience building agents with ChatGPT Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot Studio or similar platforms.• Experience in a regulated environment or with confidential and sensitive data.• Experience with agile methods and tools such as Azure DevOps or Jira.• Experience managing team members working remotely or in another location.What we offer• Become part of a global organisation with solid financial foundations, real ambition, entrepreneurial spirit and a clear strategy for growth.• Lead a team working on concrete, high-impact use cases across all business areas, and shape its technologies, practices and standards.• Combine the stability of a large organisation with the mindset and creativity of a start-up.• Work within a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment.• Benefit from attractive advantages, including an in-house fitness room, canteen and homeworking opportunities.• Receive an extensive training plan to further develop your technical, AI and leadership skills. What's in it for you: • Competitive remuneration package including:     - a 13th month (representing a mobility budget offering a car leasing opportunity),     - a discretionary performance bonus• Pension plan• Lunch vouchers• Extra days of annual leave• Flexible working hours and homeworking options• Parking spots available for a fee within our building• Possibility to charge electric vehicles in our parking • On-site employee restaurant with preferential prices• Free access to our fitness room• Sports sessions for small additional charge• Internal sports groups (e.g. running, cycling and football)• Career development opportunities through a wide range of trainings (e.g. technical and soft skills, language courses)Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d'Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, plea [...]

title: Credit Advisor (m/f)

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please let us know.Please note that every selected candidate will have to provide us with a valid criminal record check in due time.Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. description: Job Title:  Senior Consultant / Manager - Payments Operations (Banking, PI & EMI) Company:  Deloitte Tax & Consulting Job Function:  Consulting Services Level of Experience:  Experienced Contract Type:  Open-term Req ID:  14249 Job Description:  Your future teamThe payments landscape is undergoing its deepest transformation in a decade. The Instant Payments Regulation, Verification of Payee, PSD3/PSR, DORA and the evolving safeguarding expectations of the CSSF are reshaping how banks, Payment Institutions and E-Money Institutions run their payments operations.To answer the growing demand from our clients, the Banking Consulting department is strengthening its Payments team. We are looking for a Senior Consultant or Manager with strong operational payments expertise. You will join a team recognised on the Luxembourg market and connected to Deloitte's Global Payments network. You will help banks, PIs and EMIs design, run and improve their payments operations.The advantages of joining us• Strategy meets execution - every day. This role uniquely bridges high-level strategic transformation advisory and hands-on transformation delivery.• Depth in Banking, breath of topics.You will work across the full spectrum of banking transformation, helping clients design scalable, client-centric operating models and new value propositions.• Real ownership, real impact.As a Manager, you will take meaningful ownership of workstreams, client relationships, and team development from day one, directly driving outcomes for both clients and the practice.Your contribution to our success• Assess and redesign payments operating models (Target Operating Models, process flows, roles and responsibilities, outsourcing set-ups)• Lead or contribute to operational readiness for regulatory change: Instant Payments, Verification of Payee, PSD3/PSR, safeguarding• Review and optimise payments back-office processes: payment processing, investigations and exceptions, returns and recalls, reconciliations, safeguarding, cut-off and liquidity management• Design and strengthen the operational control framework, KPIs/KRIs and first-line controls, including fraud• Act as the business bridge between operations, compliance and IT teams on payments transformation programmes, without leading the technical implementation• Manage engagements and client relationships: scoping, staffing, delivery quality and budget follow-up• Contribute to business development: proposals, client meetings, market eminence and thought leadership• Coach and develop junior team members•  Your skills• 4-6 years of experience, in payments operations within a bank, a PI/EMI, a payment service provider or a consulting firm• Strong knowledge of payments operations: SEPA SCT/SDD, SCT Inst, cross-border payments, cards, e-money issuance and wallets• Good understanding of the regulatory framework: PSD2 and PSD3/PSR, EMD2, Instant Payments Regulation, AMLD, DORA, as well as the CSSF framework applicable to PIs and EMIs• Hands-on experience in process redesign, operating model definition, controls and outsourcing• Familiarity with market infrastructures and schemes (TARGET2/T2, STEP2, SWIFT, EPC rulebooks) is a strong asset• Business-oriented profile: this role focuses on operations and processes, not on IT development or system implementation• Strong analytical, structuring and communication skills, with the ability to engage with COOs, Heads of Operations and Compliance• Fluent in English and French; German is an assetInterested? title: Maintenance engineer
description: Je hebt ervaring in een soortgelijke functie. In deze functie zorg je ervoor dat gebouwen, technische installaties en ondersteunende middelen veilig, betrouwbaar en efficiënt blijven functioneren. Je houdt je bezig met preventief onderhoud, het oplossen van storingen en het doorvoeren van technische verbeteringen.Je krijgt veel zelfstandigheid en ruimte om werkzaamheden te plannen, knelpunten aan te pakken en onderhoudsprocessen verder te verbeteren. De functie is ontstaan omdat de huidige collega over een tijdje met pensioen gaat.Wat ga je doen?Als Technisch Beheerder ben je verantwoordelijk voor het onderhoud en de technische staat van gebouwen, installaties en ondersteunende middelen binnen een productieomgeving. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's van verschillende afdelingen en schakelt waar nodig externe onderhoudspartijen in.Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:*Opstellen, beheren en uitvoeren van meerjarenonderhoudsplannen voor gebouwen en technische installaties.*Coördineren en uitvoeren van preventief onderhoud, inspecties en periodieke keuringen.*Analyseren en verhelpen van technische storingen, zelfstandig of in samenwerking met externe specialisten;*Uitvoeren van kleine elektrotechnische, werktuigbouwkundige en facilitaire werkzaamheden;*Ondersteunen van de productie bij storingen aan stroomvoorzieningen, verlichting, perslucht en klimaatinstallaties;*Bewaken van keurings- en kalibratietermijnen en administratief vastleggen van de resultaten;*Coördineren van keuringen van elektrische arbeidsmiddelen en hijsgereedschappen;*Beheren en bestellen van technische materialen, gereedschappen, persoonlijke beschermingsmiddelen en overige verbruiksartikelen;*Coördineren van afvalstromen volgens de geldende wet- en regelgeving;*Signaleren van onveilige situaties en bijdragen aan veiligheidsinspecties en verbetermaatregelen.Interesse?Wil je meer weten? Neem dan contact op met Petra Ukon van Jobintenz via 06-3411372 of info@jobintenz.nl

title: Fitnessinstructeur
description: TAKEN EN VERANTWOORDELIJKHEDEN- Geef boeiende fitnessinstructie en groepslessen die leden van alle niveaus motiveren- Zorg voor de dagelijkse gang van zaken in de fitnessfaciliteit en een soepele, efficiënte dienstverlening- Ondersteun en motiveer klanten, alleen of in groepen, bij het opbouwen van gezonde, actieve gewoontes- Werk flexibel op locaties in de regio en pas je elke week aan een nieuw rooster aanWAT JIJ MEEBRENGT- Oprechte passie voor fitness en het helpen van mensen bij het opbouwen van gezondere gewoontes- Zelfverzekerde, energieke communicator die zowel individuen als groepen kan motiveren- Flexibel en aanpasbaar, en op je gemak bij wisselende werktijden op meerdere locaties- Betrouwbaar en zelfstandig, en op je gemak bij het werken met minimaal toezichtTwee merken. Één team. ROVA Health is wat er gebeurt wanneer twee gevestigde namen in gezondheid en welzijn niet langer naast elkaar, maar samen verder gaan. Gebouwd op meer dan een eeuw erfgoed van Westfield Health Group en gedreven door de overtuiging dat de manier waarop mensen leven, werken en herstellen fundamenteel is veranderd - wij bestaan om daar iets aan te doen. Dit is een platform met een doel, gebouwd door mensen die het graag goed doen. Als je bij ons komt werken, begin je niet zomaar een nieuwe baan. Je helpt mee bepalen wat er nu komt.Geen twee dagen zijn hetzelfde, en dat is precies de bedoeling. Als onze Fitness Coach ga je naartoe waar de energie het hardst nodig is.Je bent een energieke motivator die mensen in beweging brengt, alleen of in een groep, wat hun ervaring of energieniveau ook is. Samen met ons team help je de dagelijkse activiteiten van onze fitnessfaciliteiten te runnen en zorg je dat alles soepel blijft lopen voor onze leden.Je wordt ingezet in de hele regio, met flexibel ingeroosterde diensten van 7 uur. Geen twee weken zijn hetzelfde, en het kan zijn dat je op het laatste moment ergens nieuws wordt ingezet. Voor die flexibiliteit ontvang je een maandelijkse back-upbonus naast je salaris.

title: Medewerker meldkamer telecom!!
description: Ben jij een gedreven probleemoplosser en klaar voor een nieuwe uitdaging waar je veel kan leren? Dan is deze rol als Servicedesk Medewerker NOC iets voor jou! Lees verder en ontdek wat deze uitdagende functie voor jou in petto heeft!Als Servicedesk Medewerker ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor storingsmeldingen van bedrijven. Je werkt met geavanceerde monitoringsystemen om problemen op te sporen en op afstand op te lossen. Lukt dat niet, dan schakel je de 2e in. Ook stuur je vanuit kantoor de monteurs in het veld aan en ondersteun je hen waar nodig. Je dagelijkse taken op een rijtje:Het aannemen en zelf opmerken van 1e lijns storingsmeldingen.Het oplossen van storingen op afstand; indien nodig doorzetten naar 2e of 3e lijn.Het aansturen en begeleiden van monteurs in het veld.Werken in een 24/7 rooster na een uitgebreide inwerkperiode.

title: IT supportmedewerker
description: Relevante werkervaring in een soortgelijke functie is vereist. Wijj zijn op zoek naar een IT Support Medewerker die collega-s ondersteunt bij IT-vragen en storingen. Je zorgt ervoor dat medewerkers goed kunnen werken met hun systemen, software en apparatuur. Veel problemen los je zelfstandig op. Voor complexere storingen schakel je externe IT-partners in en bewaak je de voortgang.Naast de dagelijkse IT-ondersteuning werk je mee aan IT-projecten en verbeteringen. Je denkt mee over praktische oplossingen en draagt bij aan een betrouwbare en goed functionerende IT-omgeving.Wat ga je doen?*Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor collega-s met IT-vragen en zorgt ervoor dat meldingen zorgvuldig worden opgepakt en afgehandeld;*Je lost eerstelijnsproblemen op het gebied van hardware, software en randapparatuur zoveel mogelijk zelfstandig op;*Ook registreer en behandel je incidenten, serviceaanvragen en wijzigingen in een ticketsysteem.*Bij technische problemen met bijvoorbeeld Windows 11, Microsoft 365, printers en telefonie zoek je naar een passende oplossing;*Complexere storingen op netwerk- en serverniveau zet je door naar externe IT-partners. Je houdt de voortgang in de gaten en zorgt dat collega-s op de hoogte blijven;*Daarnaast stem je wensen van gebruikers en management af en werk je samen met IT-partners aan projecten en verbeteringen.Wat kun je verwachten?Je krijgt een afwisselende functie waarin je dagelijkse IT-support combineert met technische vraagstukken en projecten. Er is ruimte om zelfstandig problemen op te lossen, mee te denken over verbeteringen en je technische kennis verder te ontwikkelen.Interesse?Wil je meer weten over deze functie? Neem contact op met Petra Ukon, recruiter bij Jobintenz, via 06-34113726 of info@jobintenz.nl. Bij interesse informeren wij je graag nader over de functie en de arbeidsvoorwaarden.

title: Medior asset management professional
description: Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in assetmanagement, onderhoudsengineering of technisch projectmanagement Aantoonbare ervaring met het zelfstandig uitvoeren van analyses, implementaties of verbetertrajectenJe kunt verschillende perspectieven techniek, proces en organisatie, met elkaar verbindenJe schakelt makkelijk met stakeholders, begeleid collega's en houdt overzicht in dynamische projectenje werkt gestructureerd en weet hoe je resultaten borgt in systemen, processen en gedrag,je kent methodieken als ISO 55001 LCC, FME(C)A of ITIL en weet deze toe te passenafgeronde HBO of WO-opleidingstevige persoonlijkheid met een scherp analytisch vermogenklantgericht, professioneel en communiceert makkelijk met verchillende lagen in een organisatieWerken bij Compris:Bij Compris doen ze het net even anders. Er werken zo'n 45 bevlogen assetmanagement professionals die allemaal een zwak hebben voor techniek. Geen logge organisatie, maar korte lijnen, een betrokken directie en volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.Je werkt hier in een omgeving waar inhoud telt, maar menselijkheid net zo belangrijk is. Samen met collega's die niet alleen energie krijgen van het helpen van klanten, maar ook van elkaar.Wat je gaat doen:Als medior consultant pak je zelfstandig assetmanagementtrajecten op van begin tot eind. Je combineert tactisch advies met gewoon doen, en juist daar maak je het verschil. Je werkt aan projecten zoals het inrichten van prestatiecontracten op luchthavens of het slimmer maken van onderhoudsprocessen in de industrie.Je vertaalt strategie naar uitvoering en zorgt dat plannen ook echt landen. Of het nu gaat om het opzetten van programmeringsprocessen bij een waterbedrijf of het verbeteren van storingsregistratie en werkvoorbereiding in onderhoudssoftware, jij brengt structuur en overzicht.Je schakelt makkelijk met verschillende stakeholders en weet belangen bij elkaar te brengen in een duidelijke aanpak. Thema's als risico gestuurd onderhoud, datagedreven werken en het vertalen van beleid naar concrete onderhoudsplannen? Daar draai jij je hand niet voor om.En ondertussen help je ook collega's vooruit. Je begeleidt junior consultants en draagt actief bij aan het delen en borgen van kennis binnen Compris.

title: Medior System & Cloud Engineer
description: Met welke techniek krijg je te maken?Onder andere met Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, Windows Server, Hyper V, networking, VLANs, routing, switching, WiFi, firewalls, VPN, DNS, back up en recovery, endpoint security, EDR, monitoring, scripting en automatisering. We werken daarnaast met professionele MSP tooling voor monitoring, beheer, documentatie en automatisering.Je hoeft echt niet alles al te beheersen. Sterker nog, iemand die beweert alles te weten over ICT vertrouwen we waarschijnlijk minder dan iemand die weet wat hij nog niet weet.Wie zoeken we?Je hebt ongeveer vier jaar of meer relevante ervaring in ICT beheer, systeembeheer, cloud engineering of een vergelijkbare functie.Je kunt zelfstandig technische problemen analyseren en oplossen.Je hebt goede kennis van Microsoft 365 en moderne Microsoft omgevingen.Je begrijpt netwerken. IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs en routing zijn voor jou geen mysterieuze afkortingen.Je hebt affiniteit met security.Je kunt normaal met klanten communiceren. Ook met mensen die niet begrijpen wat DNS, MFA of een VLAN is.Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor wat je doet.Je durft vragen te stellen en je mening te geven.Je kunt zelfstandig werken zonder dat iemand continu over je schouder meekijkt.En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je bent nieuwsgierig. Want ICT verandert continu en wij dus ook.Wat verwachten we niet?Dat je iedere technologie uit deze vacature uit je hoofd kent.Dat je pakken draagt.Dat je iedere minuut van je dag verantwoordt.Dat je doet alsof je iets weet wanneer je het niet weet.En ook niet dat werken het belangrijkste onderdeel van je leven moet zijn.We willen gewoon goed werk leveren met mensen die hun vak leuk vinden.Geen zin om de hele dag alleen maar tickets weg te klikken?Mooi. Wij zoeken namelijk ook geen klassieke supportmedewerker. Bij RealNetwork zoeken we een ervaren ICTer die het vak leuk vindt en inmiddels genoeg kennis heeft opgebouwd om zelfstandig te werken, maar nog lang niet uitgeleerd is.Iemand die een storing niet alleen oplost, maar zich ook afvraagt waarom die storing überhaupt kon ontstaan. Iemand die met een klant kan praten, een Microsoft 365 omgeving kan verbeteren, een firewall kan configureren en een netwerk kan ontwerpen. Maar die er ook geen probleem van maakt om bij een nieuwe installatie zelf een kabel te trekken of een access point op te hangen.Kortom: iemand die ICT echt leuk vindt.

title: Medewerker Recreatiegebieden
description: Medewerker recreatiegebieden Veluwe aan Zee, Zeumeren, Zandenplas en Hoge Bijssel  Wat ga je doen? Dat doe je door onderhoud uit te voeren, storingen op te lossen, toezicht te houden en bezoekers te helpen. In de zomer ligt de focus op onze gasten en evenementen, in de winter werk je meer aan onderhoud en verbeteringen. Samen met je collega's zorg je ervoor dat onze recreatiegebieden er elke dag tiptop uitzien. Je werkt in een rooster en draait periodiek storingsdiensten. description:
Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands. We welcome applications from candidates across the EU who are willing to relocate to Maastricht for this opportunity.   • Good communication skills in English
  • A collaborative and proactive approach to teamwork

  • Initial 12-month contract with the intention of permanent employment
  • Extensive onboarding and GMP training programme
  • The organization offers excellent long-term career prospects and opportunities for professional growth.
  • Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands
  • Vacancy number: 27390
