ISB is an International Baccalaureate World School offering the Primary Years Programme (PYP) for younger students aged 3 to 11, the Middle Years Programme (MYP) for students aged 11 to 16 and the Diploma Programme (DP) for students in the final two years of their school careers. ISB is accredited by the New England Association of Schools and Colleges (NEASC). At ISB, we live our Mission and are committed to creating safe, caring, and affirming learning spaces for our international community. It is our aim to create a welcoming environment for students and families from across the globe and to promote learning and respect for people of all nationalities, religions and cultures. ISB's commitment to hiring and retaining quality employees has created a community of professional and dynamic teaching and administrative staff with low turnover rates and a high degree of involvement in professional development programmes. For more information about the school and our mission we invite you to visit our website at **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**International School Basel is an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and national origin. **COMMITMENT TO SAFE RECRUITMENT**International School Basel is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of students in its care. As an employer, the school expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are appointed subject to satisfactory **Criminal Records Checks, Social Media Check, Civil Litigation Check, Global Sanctions Check, and Reference Checks** with past employers. **THE POSITION**ISB seeks to appoint a passionate and dedicated Teacher of (Language and Literature) to join our Middle School Modern Languages Team. The successful candidate will teach to our Middle School students in Grades 6 to 8 within the IB Middle Years Programme. Ideally the candidate could additionally teach **Science** and/or **Individuals \& Societies** in as part of our new Middle School Dual Language Programme.Candidates applying for this role should have proven experience teaching in an international environment, ideally within an MYP context and hold a classroom teaching license and have a minimum of four years teaching experience. We will provide training to a successful candidate who does not have prior MYP experience.Please see the Description for more details. **OUR OFFER**ISB offers an excellent employment package and relocation support in an international and welcoming environment including free after\-school childcare, lessons, professional development opportunities, onsite fitness facilities and first\-class accident insurance worldwide together with an employee friendly pension plan. **HOW TO APPLY**Please apply by sending your application directly to us or by using the link available on Search Associates, the TES or the website. Referees will be contacted once a candidate has accepted an invitation to interview for the role. For registered Search Associates candidates, ISB will download your Search Associates file (including References) directly. title: Kundenberater/in Ergänzungsleistungen  80% - 100%
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Kundenberater/in Ergänzungsleistungen (Zusatzleistungen) 80% - 100%--- Kundenberater/in Ergänzungsleistungen (Zusatzleistungen) 80% \- 100%=====================================================================Ihre Aufgabe ist anspruchsvoll und vielseitig.  Sie wünschen sich eine Stelle mit Verantwortung, ein dynamisches Umfeld, eine offene Feedback\-Kultur sowie Mitgestaltungsmöglichkeiten? Das ist okay, denn wir erwarten auch einiges von Ihnen. Aber erst einmal der Reihe nach:  Reicht eine AHV\- oder IV\-Rente zum Leben nicht, entstehen oft viele Fragen. Auf diese gibt niemand kompetenter und freundlicher Antwort als unsere Kundenberaterinnen und –berater. Die Auskünfte erfolgen meist auf telefonischem oder schriftlichem Weg.  Sie berechnen und verfügen Ergänzungsleistungen. Bei Ihren Entscheiden berücksichtigen Sie die verschiedenen Gesetzgebungen. Auch in anspruchsvollen Dossiers behalten Sie stets den Überblick. Bei Änderungen unternehmen Sie die richtigen Schritte. Bei aller Fachkompetenz agieren und kommunizieren Sie stets mit Einfühlungsvermögen, denn Sie wissen, dass Ihre Berechnungen Auswirkungen haben. In Ihrer Tätigkeit stossen Sie auch immer wieder auf komplexe juristische Fragen und nehmen zur Klärung Kontakt mit unserem Rechtsdienst auf. Sie arbeiten eng mit externen Stellen wie Gemeinden, Bezirksgerichten oder Konkursämtern zusammen.  Sie sehen es, Ihr Arbeitsalltag ist abwechslungsreich und anspruchsvoll zugleich. Aber diese Challenge suchen Sie ja genau, oder?  Sie überzeugen uns fachlich und menschlich.  Sie haben sich mit einer kaufmännischen Ausbildung (E\- oder M\-Profil) auf diese anspruchsvolle Tätigkeit vorbereitet. Alternativ verfügen Sie über eine qualifizierte kaufmännische Weiterbildung mit Handelsdiplom und Erfahrung im Versicherungswesen. Besonders beeindrucken können Sie uns mit einem Fachausweis im Bereich Sozialversicherungen oder mit der Bereitschaft, ihn zu erlangen. Arbeitserfahrung in einer anspruchsvollen administrativen Tätigkeit wird Ihnen den Einstieg bei uns sehr erleichtern.  Neben Ihren fachlichen Qualifikationen verfügen Sie über eine rasche Auffassungsgabe und die Fähigkeit zu vernetztem Denken. Sie haben Freude an komplexen versicherungstechnischen Sachverhalten. Sie entscheiden gerne und kommunizieren klar. Ein dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit viel Gestaltungsraum ist ganz nach Ihren Geschmack und in konstruktivem Feedback sehen Sie die Chance zur Weiterentwicklung.  Wer viel mitbringt, darf auch viel erwarten.  Die SVA Zürich ist das Kompetenzzentrum für Sozialversicherungen. Sie gehört zu den Top\- Arbeitgebenden im Kanton und liegt in Fussdistanz zum Hauptbahnhof Zürich. Dass unsere rund 1200 Mitarbeitenden überdurchschnittlich zufrieden sind, hat gute Gründe: eine Tätigkeit, die Sinn macht, flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Home\-Office, gute Sozialleistungen und eine wertschätzende Du\-Kultur. Wollen Sie sich beruflich und persönlich weiterentwickeln? Herzlich willkommen bei uns!Mehr über die SVA Zürich erfahren Sie auf .  Wir freuen uns auf Sie.  Weitere Informationen zu dieser Stelle erhalten Sie von unserer HR\-Fachfrau,  **Brdar**, Telefon .  ![Sozialversicherungsanstalt des Kantons Zürich SVA]()* Sozialversicherungsanstalt des Kantons Zürich SVA  Röntgenstrasse 17  8005 Zürich*jid04f3245jm jit1044jm jiy26jm

title: Portfolio Manager
description: About MillenniumMillennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors. Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact. •Employer:        MCP (Switzerland) GmbH •Job Title:            Portfolio Manager•Office Location:    Zug, SwitzerlandMeet the TeamWe are seeking a Portfolio Manager to manage risk and generate returns while utilizing cutting-edge machine learning and agentic AI solutions within our Quantitative Trading divisions. This role sits at the intersection of Portfolio Management and Artificial Intelligence, requiring active engagement with autonomous cognitive systems for strategy development. What You’ll Do•Focus on machine learning and agentic systems to manage a live trading book while working with cognitive reasoning architectures that enable autonomous systems to solve complex financial problems and reason through multi-step solutions. •Utilize and interact with agentic systems, including planning algorithms, memory architectures, reflection mechanisms, and collaborative reasoning patterns that support autonomous decision-making in quantitative trading environments.•Fine-tune genetic algorithms hyperparameters to optimize adaptive system performance, decision-making quality, and contribute to deep learning model development for the PM model layer and custom agentic workflows.•Responsible for portfolio management: take risk, manage P&L, and make trading decisions within defined risk parameters while developing expertise in quantitative portfolio management principles.•Utilize agentic systems, deploying and working with cognitive reasoning systems for quantitative modeling problems, leveraging planning, tool use, memory, reflection, and collaboration capabilities•Contribute to machine learning model building for PM model layer applications specific to portfolio management objectives•Build and customize agentic workflows and tools tailored to portfolio management needs and specific trading strategies•Execute human-in-the-loop decisions and checks ensuring that traded strategies meet quant trading acceptance criteriaThis position combines portfolio management with cutting-edge agentic AI technology. Your work will directly impact:•Research-to-production cycles for quantitative strategies•Complex, multi-step financial workflows through autonomous systems•Enhanced decision-making through human-AI collaborationWhat You Bring•Master’s or Ph.D. degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Engineering, or related discipline)•Minimum of 10 years of experience with Python-based development, including machine learning model development. •Experience with building agentic AI frameworks.•Deep knowledge of the core capabilities of agentic systems: planning, tool use, memory, reflection, and collaboration.•Experience applying genetic algorithm methodologies to develop adaptive systems that evolve and improve through selection, crossover, mutation, and fitness-based optimization.•Experience adjusting hyperparameters and tune training processes for genetic algorithms.•Familiarity with financial markets and a willingness to learn portfolio management discipline, including P&L responsibility and risk management.

title: Internisten (m/w/d) für die umfassende Patientenversorgung in der Schweiz (Facharzt/-ärztin - Innere Medizin)
description: Für mehrere Regionen in der Schweiz suchen wir zur erweiterten Grundversorgung von Patienten mehrere Internisten und Internistinnen. Die Kliniken, für die wir aktiv suchen, engagieren sich nach neuestem Wissensstand in der Inneren Medizin.Indem sie sich mit anderen Gesundheitsexperten in der Schweiz vernetzen, ermöglichen sie eine umfassende und hochwirksame Versorgung. Man legt großen Wert auf medizinische Qualität und persönliche Behandlung. Dazu gehört, dass für jede Patientin und Patienten eine individuell abgestimmte Therapie ermöglicht wird. Die Bedürfnisse aller Patientinnen und Patienten stehen stets an erster Stelle.Unsere starke Partnerschaft mit Kliniken aus dem ganzen Land ermöglicht Ihnen eine hochwertige Arbeitsumgebung und eine schnelle Anstellung.Für mehrere äußerst interessante Arbeitgeber suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung fachlich qualifizierte und engagierte Personen alsInternistin oder Internist für die Patientenversorgung in einem Schweizer Kanton Ihrer Wahl.Zuständigkeiten / HauptaufgabenDie folgenden Punkte variieren je nach Standort ein wenig.- **Diagnose, Behandlung und Prävention:** Internisten befassen sich mit der Vorbeugung, Diagnose und konservativen (nicht-chirurgischen) Behandlung von Krankheiten der inneren Organe. Dazu gehören unter anderem Herz-Kreislauf-Erkrankungen, Diabetes, Erkrankungen der Atemwege (Lunge), Verdauungserkrankungen, Nierenleiden, hormonelle Störungen, rheumatische Erkrankungen, Infektionskrankheiten und Bluterkrankungen.- Patientenanamnese und körperliche Untersuchung:Sie erheben eine detaillierte Krankengeschichte (Anamnese) und führen umfassende körperliche Untersuchungen durch.- Anordnung und Interpretation von Untersuchungen:Sie entscheiden, welche Labor-, bildgebenden (z.B. Röntgen, Ultraschall) oder funktionellen Untersuchungen (z.B. EKG, Lungenfunktion) notwendig sind, ordnen diese an und interpretieren die Ergebnisse.- Erstellung von Behandlungsplänen:Basierend auf der Diagnose entwickeln sie individuelle Behandlungspläne, verschreiben Medikamente und überwachen den Therapieerfolg.- Betreuung chronischer Erkrankungen:Sie sind häufig die erste Anlaufstelle und betreuen Patienten mit chronischen Erkrankungen.- Beratung zu Krankheitsmanagement und Prävention:Sie beraten Patienten umfassend zum Umgang mit ihrer Krankheit, zu präventiven Maßnahmen und zur Gesundheitsförderung.- Koordination der Patientenversorgung:Sie arbeiten eng mit anderen Fachärzten (z.B. Chirurgen, Kardiologen, Rheumatologen) und anderen Gesundheitsberufen zusammen, um eine ganzheitliche und interdisziplinäre Betreuung zu gewährleisten. Sie überweisen Patienten an Spezialärzte, wenn spezielle Behandlungen erforderlich sind.- Notfallmedizinische Versorgung:In der Notfallversorgung überwachen und behandeln Sie Patienten mit akut bedrohlichen Zuständen.- Umfassende Betreuung:Sie kümmern sich um Patienten aller Altersstufen, wobei besonders in der Praxis ältere und multimorbide Patienten (Patienten mit mehreren chronischen Erkrankungen) häufig sind. Sie sind auch in der Palliativmedizin tätig, um Patienten mit nicht heilbaren Krankheiten zu betreuen.- Führungsverantwortung, Lehre und Forschung:Sie übernehmen auch Führungsaufgaben in Kliniken, engagieren sich in der Ausbildung des medizinischen Nachwuchses und sind an wissenschaftlicher Forschung beteiligt.Qualifikationen / Anforderungen- Facharzttitel für Allgemeine Innere Medizin (AIM) gerne mit Spezialisierung sowie erfüllte Voraussetzungen für die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen(EU-Facharzttitel, EU-Approbation und EU-Staatsbürgerschaft)- Berufserfahrung mindestens 2 Jahre- Freude an Teamarbeit, am Teaching von Kolleginnen/Kollegen in Weiterbildung und an konstruktiver, interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit- Eine offene, kommunikative Persönlichkeit mit einer patienten-, kunden- und mitarbeiterorientierten Grundhaltung und hohem Engagement- Erfahrung in einer angiologischen (Kader-)StellungQualifikation für die Durchführung von PTA von Vorteil- Interesse und Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit- Die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen müssen beim Bewerbungsbeginn nicht vorhanden sein, jedoch beim Stellenantritt. Bei der Einreichung der Unterlagen kann auf unsere Erfahrung zurückgegriffen werden.- Stilsicheres Deutsch, resp. CHF 170.000,- bis CHF 200.000,- brutto pro Jahr bei Vollzeit und bemisst sich je nach Berufserfahrung, Aus- und Weiterbildung- Vielfältige Aus- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten- Landschaftlich reizvolle Arbeitsplätze zwischen Bergen und Seen- Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement, diverse Angebote für Mitarbeiter, Work-Life-Balance- Sehr gute Familien und KinderbetreuungHilfe zum StartSie schätzen Herausforderungen, wollen neue Ziele erreichen und stellen sich gerne anspruchsvollen Aufgaben?Es erwartet Sie bei Ihrem neuen Arbeitsplatz ein engagiertes und motiviertes Team, dem Zuverlässigkeit und Respekt wichtig sind. title: Team Leader des infirmiers à domicile 80% - Genève
description: Ref 2587540 \| Date: 26 Oct 2026![Unilabs]( )Team Leader des infirmiers à domicile 80% \- Genève**À propos de nous**Unilabs est l'une des principales entreprises de diagnostic en Europe et propose aux patients, sur quatre continents, une offre complète de services de laboratoire, de pathologie et d'imagerie. En tant que leader du numérique couvrant l'ensemble du domaine du diagnostic, les plus de 13'000 collaborateurs d'Unilabs dans le monde sauvent des vies chaque jour. Unilabs investit massivement dans la technologie, l'équipement et le personnel et utilise les technologies numériques de pointe dans ses laboratoires et instituts d'imagerie pour améliorer la vie de près de 100 millions de personnes chaque année.**Vos responsabilités**Vous aimez accompagner une équipe et rester proche du terrain ?  Unilabs recherche une ou un Team Leader à 80%, basé à Genève, pour encadrer son équipe d'infirmiers à domicile en Suisse romande, dès le 1er janvier 2027\.  Vous jouez un rôle clé dans l'organisation des tournées, la qualité des prélèvements et l'accompagnement des collaborateurs.**Compétences requises****Vos missions:**  Encadrer, motiver et accompagner l'équipe au quotidien.  Organiser les plannings et les tournées selon les besoins des patients et les disponibilités de l'équipe.  Accueillir les nouveaux collaborateurs et suivre leur intégration, leurs compétences et leurs besoins de formation.  Veiller au respect des procédures de prélèvement, des règles d'hygiène et de sécurité ainsi que des conditions de conservation des échantillons.  Assurer une coordination efficace avec la responsable, les laboratoires.  Suivre l'activité, identifier les difficultés et proposer des améliorations.  Veiller à la disponibilité du matériel et participer aux prélèvements à domicile selon les besoins.**Votre profil:**  Formation en soins infirmiers et expérience confirmée dans les prélèvements sanguins.  Une expérience à domicile et dans l'encadrement d'équipe constitue un atout.  Sens de l'organisation, autonomie et capacité à gérer les imprévus.  Maîtrise du français ; anglais souhaité**Vos qualités humaines sont essentielles:**  Nous recherchons une personne à l'écoute, bienveillante et fiable, capable de créer une relation de confiance avec les patients et les collaborateurs.  Vous savez fédérer une équipe, reconnaître les contributions de chacun et encourager l'entraide. Vous communiquez avec clarté et respect, donnez des retours constructifs et gérez les tensions avec calme et équité. Votre disponibilité et votre exemplarité font de vous un véritable soutien pour l'équipe.  **Envie de nous rejoindre ?**  Adressez\-nous votre CV accompagné de quelques lignes présentant votre motivation.  Lieu de travail : Genève, avec un périmètre d'activité en Suisse romande  Taux d'activité : 80%  Entrée en fonction : 1er janvier 2027**Nous offrons*** Un environnement de travail passionnant et dynamique, avec une dimension internationale* La possibilité de prendre des responsabilités et de développer votre potentiel* Une atmosphère de travail positive dans un cadre collaboratif et une culture d'entreprise pronant le respect et la reconnaissance* Des avantages sociaux attractifs, ainsi qu'une semaine de travail de 40 heures et 5 semaines de vacances par année* Un forfait annuel pour vos analyses personnelles et tarifs spéciaux pour les actes de radiologie effectués au sein du Groupe Unilabs**Contact**  Envoyer cette annonce à un amijpidafd84e3jm jpit1044jm jpiy26jm

Technicien·ne de maintenance à 100 %
======================================

*Depuis plus de 60 ans, nous nous engageons auprès des Organisations internationales en leur offrant des surfaces administratives et de conférences idéales. Expression concrète et active de la politique d’Etat hôte de la Confédération suisse et de celle du Canton de Genève, la Fondation des Immeubles pour les Organisations Internationales (FIPOI) propose une série de prestations destinées à faciliter l’implantation et les activités des organisations internationales qui s’installent à Genève. Pour les concevoir, les gérer et les entretenir dans le respect des plus hauts standards de qualité que nous nous fixons, nous pouvons compter sur les compétences et l’engagement d’une équipe performante d’une soixantaine de collaboratrices et collaborateurs.*

 

Afin de renforcer le secteur technique de notre Service Immobilier, nous recherchons :

 

### Un·e **Technicien·ne de maintenance à 100 %**

 

**Votre mission**

 

Basé\-e à proximité de la Place des Nations à Genève, vous travaillerez en lien direct avec le Chef d’Unité du secteur Technique, votre mission principale est d’assurer la maintenance technique des installations CVCSE du parc immobilier propriété de notre Fondation.

 

**Vos responsabilités**

* Effectuer la maintenance des installations CVC, sanitaires, éclairages, courant fort, courant faible ainsi que des systèmes de régulation numérique.
* Participer au suivi et au dépannage niveau 1 des installations de sécurité : contrôles d’accès, détection incendie, extinction automatique, énergies et éclairages de secours.
* Intervenir sereinement et efficacement sur des dépannages urgents, notamment sur des recherches de pannes dans des tableaux électriques de commande.
* Être force de proposition dans l’amélioration des installations et des équipements.
* Collaborer activement à la conduite de certains projets et assurer le suivi des interventions liées aux contrats de maintenance.
* Optimiser le fonctionnement des installations d’un point de vue énergétique.


 

**Votre profil**

* Formation dans le domaine électrique (CFC ou équivalent).
* Première expérience réussie dans la maintenance de bâtiments.
* Connaissance des systèmes d’automates programmables et de supervision MCR, GTC.
* Esprit d’analyse et solide maîtrise technique.
* Polyvalent·e, sérieux·se et autonome.
* De nature ouverte, vous échangez avec facilité et courtoisie dans l’objectif d’entretenir une relation orientée client.


 

**Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?**

Rejoindre la FIPOI, c’est intégrer une organisation au cœur de la Genève internationale, porteuse d’une mission d’intérêt public et évoluant dans un environnement multiculturel stimulant.

 

La FIPOI est certifiée Great Place to Work® depuis 2021, une reconnaissance qui reflète son engagement durable en faveur d’un climat de travail fondé sur la confiance, le respect, la collaboration et le développement des compétences.

 

Elle propose des conditions de travail attractives, un cadre professionnel stable et exigeant, ainsi que l’opportunité de s’inscrire dans un projet à long terme au service des organisations internationales établies à Genève.

 

**Candidature**

Si vous vous reconnaissez dans cette description et que vous êtes prêt·e à relever ce défi avec engagement, nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre dossier de candidature via la plateforme JobUp. Nous vous garantissons une parfaite discrétion. Délai de candidature au 26 novembre 2026\.

description: Office Administrator – Audit Corporates Office Administrator – Audit Corporates=========================================**Discover KPMG – Become part of our team**  With 300 different auditing and advisory service opportunities, our people can choose the career path that suits them best. Surrounded by motivated and open\-minded experts, you can exchange ideas, challenge perspectives, and help shape the future.  **Mentoring and Networking**  At KPMG, we support your professional and personal development through personalized mentoring programs and a collaborative culture.  From programs such as WoMentoring for early\-career professionals to networking opportunities and social events, you will build meaningful relationships with colleagues and clients. We value diverse perspectives and believe they are key to innovation and professional growth.**Flexible Working**  With us, you'll find the support and flexibility you need to balance your career and private life. You can benefit from hybrid working models, flexible working hours, the option to work from abroad (up to 10 working days per calendar year), and generous parental leave. You also have the option to purchase additional vacation days.  **Additional Benefits**  Successful employees need top\-tier IT infrastructure and excellent mobility\-not only at work but also in their private lives. KPMG covers your mobile phone bill, provides financial support for your mobile device and offers an SBB Half\-Fare Travelcard. Parking spaces are also available at fair prices. Our lunch allowance supports your daily meals, and you benefit from additional discounts across various areas.**Generous Parental Leave**  We offer generous parental leave: 18 weeks of maternity leave and 4 weeks of paternity leave, which can be taken within the first year after the birth or adoption of your child. Fathers may also apply for up to two additional months of unpaid leave.  To further support families, we offer places in holiday camps for children aged 6 to 15 during school holidays in cooperation with MS Sports. Additional support services are available through our Parents Circle.**Inspired by Innovation**  At KPMG, you'll work with highly qualified, ambitious experts. In our inspiring environment, clear thinking and strong perspectives matter more than hierarchies\-because good ideas always come first. We support you with cutting\-edge tools and state\-of\-the\-art AI technologies, enabling you to actively participate in and shape technological progress in your daily work.**An inclusive culture**  Our commitment to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion is reflected in our policies and practices. Become part of a culture that celebrates individuality. In our various communities (KNOW, KNOW , Pride, and Internationals at KPMG), you can connect with like\-minded colleagues.  **Health \& Wellbeing**  We promote employee wellbeing with a strong focus on mental health. Our offerings range from practical self\-care webinars to leadership training. In addition, we provide discounts on numerous fitness programs and sports activities\-ideal for integrating movement into your workday.**Pension Fund**  We offer above\-average benefits to help you build a solid retirement plan.**Our Commitment**  Quality and integrity are essential at KPMG to build trust and drive change. materials.Complete relevant invigilator training prior to examination periods or at the start of each academic year as directed.An ideal candidate will:Be reliable, flexible, and readily available Exams Officer/SAT Coordinator prior to each exam session.Keep confidential examination question papers and materials secure.Ensure examination rooms are set up according to required arrangements.Admit plans.Distribute the correct question papers and examination materials to candidates.Instruct candidates on the conduct of their exams and deal with candidate questions.Start examinations on description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Middle School (Language and Literature) Teacher (ideally able to teach Science and/or Individuals and Societies in )--- Middle School (Language and Literature) Teacher (ideally able to teach Science and/or Individuals and Societies in )====================================================================================================================**SCHOOL PROFILE**The International School Basel (ISB) is an English\-language international day school for students from ages 3 to 18\. ISB is home to approximately 1,110 students who enjoy modern purpose\-built facilities on three campuses clustered a few kilometers south of Basel in the towns of Reinach and Aesch. ISB is an International Baccalaureate World School offering the Primary Years Programme (PYP) for younger students aged 3 to 11, the Middle Years Programme (MYP) for students aged 11 to 16 and the Diploma Programme (DP) for students in the final two years of their school careers. ISB is accredited by the New England Association of Schools and Colleges (NEASC). At ISB, we live our Mission and are committed to creating safe, caring, and affirming learning spaces for our international community. It is our aim to create a welcoming environment for students and families from across the globe and to promote learning and respect for people of all nationalities, religions and cultures. ISB's commitment to hiring and retaining quality employees has created a community of professional and dynamic teaching and administrative staff with low turnover rates and a high degree of involvement in professional development programmes. For more information about the school and our mission we invite you to visit our website at **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**International School Basel is an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and national origin. **COMMITMENT TO SAFE RECRUITMENT**International School Basel is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of students in its care. As an employer, the school expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are appointed subject to satisfactory **Criminal Records Checks, Social Media Check, Civil Litigation Check, Global Sanctions Check, and Reference Checks** with past employers. **THE POSITION**ISB seeks to appoint a passionate and dedicated Teacher of (Language and Literature) to join our Middle School Modern Languages Team. The successful candidate will teach to our Middle School students in Grades 6 to 8 within the IB Middle Years Programme. Ideally the candidate could additionally teach **Science** and/or **Individuals \& Societies** in as part of our new Middle School Dual Language Programme.Candidates applying for this role should have proven experience teaching in an international environment, ideally within an MYP context and hold a classroom teaching license and have a minimum of four years teaching experience. We will provide training to a successful candidate who does not have prior MYP experience.Please see the Description for more details. **OUR OFFER**ISB offers an excellent employment package and relocation support in an international and welcoming environment including free after\-school childcare, lessons, professional development opportunities, onsite fitness facilities and first\-class accident insurance worldwide together with an employee friendly pension plan. **HOW TO APPLY**Please apply by sending your application directly to us or by using the link available on Search Associates, the TES or the website. Your application should include: Letter of Application (2 pages maximum); up\-to\-date Curriculum Vitae; and names and contact details of at least two (although three is preferred) professional referees who have line\-managed you: one of whom must be your current Head of School (if this poses major difficulties, please state reasons in your letter of application). If you have been at your current school for less than 2 years, one of your referees must also be the Head of your previous school. Referees will be contacted once a candidate has accepted an invitation to interview for the role. For registered Search Associates candidates, ISB will download your Search Associates file (including References) directly. Due to work permit restrictions, preference will be given to candidates of EU/Swiss nationalities and candidates who hold a current Swiss work permit. Kindly note that the School reserves the right to end the search early should a suitable candidate be identified. **WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION!**![International School of the Basel Region AG]()* International School of the Basel Region AG  Fleischbachstrasse 2  4153 Reinach BL*jid3be8078jm jit1044jm jiy26jm

title: Senior Primary Teacher for Innovative Private School in Zurich (Grades 1–3)
description: Teaching jobs like this don’t come around often. The chance to know each child deeply because class sizes are deliberately small, one teacher for every seven children. To reimagine education for a rapidly changing world. To work alongside a deeply passionate and high-performing team of educators. To let your creative ideas flow and actually bring them to life.Full job description here  here https://tinyurl.com/2c3crwud Role at a glance-Role:Senior Primary Teacher, grades 1–3- Location: Adliswil, Switzerland- Start date: August 2027, with the possibility of starting part-time earlier if available- Commitment:80–100% (additional part-time arrangements may also be possible)- Languages:Fluent English; German proficiency is a strong plus but not required- Experience: Substantial teaching experience, typically 7+ years- Compensation:Typically 15–25% higher than most Zurich private schools, with salaries benchmarked to the official Zurich public teacher scale.About UsAt Lumos School, we believe education should be both academically rigorous and joyful. We are a small, innovative German–English bilingual private school in Zürich, currently serving Grades 1–7 and growing towards Grade 9.Our exceptionally low student-to-teacher ratio of 1:7 allows us to provide personalized learning, individual coaching and meaningful relationships with every child.Our educational philosophy focuses on four principles: learning how to learn, combining challenge with enjoyment (“hard fun”), developing student independence and balancing academic mastery with exploration.We embrace hands-on projects, mixed-age learning, creativity and innovative teaching methods.The RoleWe are looking for an experienced, passionate and creative Senior Primary Teacher to join our Grades 1–3 team.You will take responsibility for curriculum planning, classroom teaching, assessment and student development while working collaboratively with another experienced teacher.We encourage our teachers to go beyond prescribed curricula, using their expertise and creativity to design engaging, meaningful learning experiences.You will play a particularly important role in developing English language and literacy, including phonics, reading, writing, vocabulary and communication skills, while supporting multilingual learners at different proficiency levels.Our two-teacher classroom model encourages shared planning, flexible responsibilities, constructive feedback and genuine collaboration.What We're Looking ForA teaching degree and typically 7+ years of classroom experience, preferably in Grades 1–3.Fluent English; German is a strong advantage but not required.Strong expertise in early primary education, literacy, phonics and numeracy.Experience in curriculum planning, assessment and differentiated instruction.Understanding of bilingual education and multilingual learners.Excellent classroom organization and management skills.Confidence working with mixed-age groups and personalized learning approaches.Experience with Montessori, project-based learning or other innovative educational methods is advantageous.Familiarity with Swiss Lehrplan 21 is helpful but not essential.Eligibility to work in Switzerland.Who You AreWe are looking for someone who genuinely loves teaching young children and understands their need for warmth, encouragement, structure, movement and play.You are confident, creative, organized and proactive. You enjoy taking responsibility but are equally comfortable sharing ideas, decisions and classroom ownership.You value collaboration, communicate clearly, welcome feedback and continuously seek ways to improve your teaching.Most importantly, you are excited about helping children reach their potential while contributing to a thoughtful, ambitious and growing school.What We OfferCompetitive salaries: Typically 15–25% above most Zürich private schools, benchmarked against the Zürich public teacher salary scale.16+ weeks of school holidays.Significant protected planning time.Relocation support where needed.Exceptionally low student-to-teacher ratio of 1:7.Professional autonomy and freedom to develop creative teaching approaches.Supportive leadership and highly experienced international colleagues.Engaged families who share our educational values.A collaborative, innovative and forward-thinking working environment.The opportunity to contribute ideas and help shape the future of our school.Join UsAt Lumos, we believe exceptional teachers make exceptional schools.We are looking for someone who sees teaching as more than a profession: someone who brings experience, imagination, warmth and genuine enthusiasm to the classroom.If you believe children learn best when they are inspired, challenged and supported, we would love to hear from you.

International Corporate Communications Project Leader
=====================================================

**The company**

Tissot has been growing and developing its tradition of innovation since 1853\. From the early days to the present, in its home in Le Locle in the Swiss Jura mountains, Tissot has translated craftsmanship and precision into stylish timepieces now sold in over 160 countries around the world. Special materials, advanced functionality and meticulous design details join forces to create the luxury of accessibility.

Today Tissot is a member of the Swatch Group, the world's largest watch producer and distributor of Swiss watches. The tradition of innovation lives on, keeping closely in touch with the times.

We are looking for a **Senior International Corporate Communications Project Leader** to join our international team based in Le Locle. The successful candidate will be part of the international PR team and report to the PR Manager.

**Job description**

In this role, you will take ownership of corporate communications, ensuring clear, consistent and impactful messaging across key audiences and channels. Working closely with senior leadership and internal stakeholders, you will support high\-profile communications opportunities and lead a range of corporate communications projects.

The role combines strong editorial skills, strategic awareness, discretion and the ability to build trusted relationships across the organisation and with external stakeholders.

**Your responsibilities**

* Own and coordinate corporate communications activities, ensuring consistency of messaging and corporate narrative.
* Support the PR Manager and senior leadership on corporate communications, media opportunities and high\-profile engagements.
* Develop and coordinate corporate communications materials and messaging across relevant channels, including digital and social media.
* Lead selected corporate communications projects from development through to execution.
* Build strong relationships with media, internal stakeholders and external partners.
* Support communications in sensitive or high\-pressure situations, ensuring clear and consistent messaging.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen corporate visibility, reputation and positioning.
* Monitor relevant media, corporate and industry developments and provide insights to inform communications.
* Contribute to the continuous development of corporate communications tools and practices.


**Profile**

* Excellent communicator with strong editorial judgement and storytelling skills
* Strategic, creative and curious, with a strong understanding of corporate reputation and communications
* Confident working with senior stakeholders and handling sensitive information with discretion
* Highly organised, proactive and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build trusted relationships across functions and markets
* Detail\-oriented, agile and solutions\-focused, with the ability to see the bigger picture
* A genuine sensitivity to brand image, corporate reputation and the luxury environment


**Professional requirements**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience
* Minimum 7 years of experience in a similar role, preferably in an international environment
* Proven experience in corporate communications, editorial content and media relations
* Experience working with senior executives and supporting high\-profile communications
* Strong writing, editing and storytelling skills
* Experience in luxury, fashion, beauty, lifestyle or premium consumer sectors is a plus
* Experience in digital and social communications is an advantage


**Languages**

* Fluent in English and French, both written and spoken, is a must
* German is an advantage
* Additional languages are a plus


**Company address**

Chemin des Tourelles 17 \- 2400 Le Locle

title: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor
description: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)  Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Eawag conducts research, education and expert consulting to achieve the dual goals of meeting direct human needs for water and maintaining the function and integrity of aquatic ecosystems.  The Department of Process Engineering (ENG) has a vacancy for a  Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)  Densified Activated Sludge (DAS), a hybrid system consisting of flocs and small granules (typically 200\~500 ?m in diameter), is a promising solution for the increasing stringent effluent quality standards and the intensification of biological processes in wastewater treatment. Compared to conventional activated sludge, DAS offers significant advantages to "do more with less" \- increasing treatment capacity without expanding the plant footprint. The improved settleability enables high biomass retention, thereby substantially increasing volumetric treatment capacity. The enrichment of slow\-growing bacteria, particularly nitrifiers, promotes microbial activities and provides greater flexibility for optimizing aeration strategies for enhancing nutrient removal.  The application of DAS in sequencing batch reactors (SBR) is being increasingly investigated and implemented worldwide, yielding many new valuable experimental findings and operational experience. However, a comprehensive understanding of long\-term performance of DAS\-SBR systems under dynamic conditions remains limited. Existing mathematical models do not yet adequately represent all relevant processes and characteristics, nor have they been calibrated and validated using real\-world operational data.  This project aims to develop a DAS\-SBR model in Sumo, which can better represent the key biological and physical processes observed in practice. By calibrating and validating the model against real\-world datasets, the project seeks to improve the understanding of DAS\-SBR system and to provide a reliable tool for process analysis, optimization, and future design.  We are looking for a motivated master thesis student or intern, who needs to be enrolled in a university for the entire thesis/internship duration, with interests in advanced technologies for biological wastewater treatment and modelling biological processes. Fluent spoken and written English are essential. Strong data analysis and programming skills and experience with modelling in Sumo are highly recommended. The preferred starting date is September/October 2026 onwards, not later than March 2027\.  At Eawag, we have a working environment in which people with different experiences, strengths, and perspectives can fully contribute and further develop. Here, you can help us advance! We promote genuine participation, exchange, and mutual understanding. We create structures that enable the compatibility of work and other areas of life, such as care work, and continuously make efforts to reduce barriers.  Do you have specific requirements regarding the application process or the position, or do you need additional information? Talk to us about it\-we will be happy to support you with possible flexible workplace, working hours, and job design solutions. For further information about Eawag and its conditions of employment, please visit and /.  Applications can be submitted until the position is filled and will therefore be evaluated on a rolling basis. Applications should include a short letter (. one page) describing your interests and their relevance to this position, a CV, and a list of lectures/transcripts of records from the university.  For further information, please contact Mengqi Zhu or Dr Derlon.  We look forward to receiving your application. Please send it through this webpage, as any other way of applying will not be considered. A click on the link below will take you directly to the application form.  Apply now  Eawag: Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology jpid92ba563jm jit0731jm jiy26jm
